| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=53049a858c974452ae4460185a6117e6&_e=M8_MzoLDASLHb3QmejpGSHtmW_lVWArYA2qCAzeUPTUaDj5PlCiKr7xn-GVHLiyzY7nB4dYwanI4AU-B4N-6Tob-nKEpw6FyClGYRFoZ7AXHP10ZyG8tkk5F5H_D4w4rUTZf0aYjma0L5sFoIyN0AUQwoJujbFFdYH6ICtXncQFqJmz76cB0a4mambQdO9gF6XGqMVriGk9SPFNBsaEH1RDB7kyWXIIePfQx_T9qGgPEGu8jpGl-42loMXJoySqHqh0Pm8qI6GTPyqY1-NZRReOshkdvLTnobbKkQNx1r5kAr-Gwa5gGPnAT9mjroJsuADzsPmopDDv4OXusPza1TifiWoLlGC6CZfeC3D-NNtJJwy3PbQhJ8fowB08U1ybMwnwyDXfXN85Pu5ESsDebXGUCgVbBkuRtKVApru6k3yhyxZKEAHzKqtJT9zRg2H4m).

Tomorrow, tens of thousands of voters in CA-30 will have their ballots counted to decide the future of our district. Before the big day, I want to take a minute to make one last pitch as to why you should elect me as your next representative. It has been the privilege of my life to serve this community. As a Councilmember, Mayor of the City of Glendale, and as your representative in the State Assembly for the past seven years, I’ve always been a fighter for our progressive values. I championed bold policies to create more affordable housing, protect our reproductive freedoms, and make California a model for environmental sustainability and clean renewable energy, even as big oil fought us. I faced intimidation and threats after I voted to ban the Glendale Gun Show from being held near our schools, because – above all else – I’m committed to keeping our community safe. And when sexual harassment scandals struck state government, I led the charge to hold perpetrators accountable. I’m ready to deliver for this community -- on the climate crisis, housing, healthcare access, and so much more. But I cannot do this alone. Taking our locally-grown values to Washington is going to require this whole community coming together, and I cannot put into words how much I have appreciated your support every step of the way. As a Councilmember, Mayor of the City of Glendale, and as your representative in the State Assembly for the past seven years, I’ve always been a fighter for our progressive values. I championed bold policies to create more affordable housing, protect our reproductive freedoms, and make California a model for environmental sustainability and clean renewable energy, even as big oil fought us. I faced intimidation and threats after I voted to ban the Glendale Gun Show from being held near our schools, because – above all else – I’m committed to keeping our community safe. I’m ready to deliver for this community -- on the climate crisis, housing, healthcare access, and so much more. But I cannot do this alone. You don’t hear much about Cuba, but the Communist island nation has one of the most impressive and dangerous intelligence agencies in the world. This week an American career diplomat, Manuel Rocha, [admitted](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=c5f3239820214cf98b225362a7f57028&_e=bFzJftylW-Ql_ULQe-OTXZFYJAw1lWco2vtO27OgwGnUMG1yGnnx6v-b1W7TiUFbf2x3vzUmGMgk3ntqXQLEH4wOKO5lolNUttT-_JiaVgDeKaQaO13AKTJPgFlwI1Vcs4xBarjZA3g-r-7SQH0VY0uldh2GaaIDnsv2jAqmupd46PiYX_CggDBJFsF31_WCZa62tI_vEcl4p5_b0TxZM4E9N4Qavfyv17DSAxwDi8dNJZIjQpO-4hbZZ5QAMmftdkxFAbZ5Vk1tWC1wtZwk-v7_34TtUmGKwZv9ceaaCyGK6g6NJ5v9EhrfZozz4YO4) that he had been spying for Havana since at least 1981, the year he joined the foreign service. He had served as ambassador to Bolivia and top posts in Argentina, Mexico, the White House and the U.S. Interests Section in Havana. The extent of the damage he caused is still being investigated and may never be fully known, but it highlights how we need robust counterintelligence efforts to find would-be spies and prevent moles from happening in the first place.

What you may not know is just how much the CCP relies on private cybersecurity firms to do its hacking. Recently [leaked documents](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=c5f3239820214cf98b225362a7f57028&_e=bFzJftylW-Ql_ULQe-OTXYoN_3aqdX1GRdJUvVsgVtFT05awEh1BP-SaQpViLICJh2KAU21IIYLYUAWHDZQHhZ8kpl0O8kms4se36PyyM_Uflhbgb4jbjjpivVlJllSlUVhiFcenW_zXHMuJJl2qDDU-irUwbGd5SafLG3yLM0BsnXtwUi5tcCNUykg6vDMSjD23XCAIAwodymxOO9i9Yx2yZf9id4d6Ub5gMJrXBGqLq1Bho6OROU2WhxXZsT1yJG8htTyzp5KeyBDWgLt9JS5lJ_XU86l4Fqzf4Lf7ZehBM178WKJtD2K_8_6Nt64y) show how Beijing uses companies like I-Soon to target foreign governments and companies, and even domestic minority populations like the Uyghurs. | | **For Immediate Release:** March 4, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Dave Min Endorsed by The Korea Daily**
**IRVINE, CA** — Dave Min's campaign for Congress proudly announces the endorsement of The Korea Daily, one of the largest and most influential Korean-language newspapers in the United States. The 47th District, home to a substantial Korean community, relies on leaders who understand and champion the unique needs of its residents. This endorsement not only validates Min's commitment to representing diverse voices but also underscores his dedication to fighting for the rights and dignity of all constituents in California's 47th Congressional District.

Weiss' campaign has a troubling history of resorting to divisive and racially charged rhetoric, raising serious concerns about her ability to properly represent the sizable AAPI community in Orange County. [In a letter published](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=75324e81cf&e=7017cc100e) on January 29, 2024, members and leaders in the AAPI community in Orange County expressed frustration over Weiss' campaign tactics, stating: **“We are tired of so-called allies in anti-racism resorting to the language of ‘othering’ to discredit fellow Democrats.”

“Let me be clear: these tactics are not only repugnant but also an affront to everything we stand for as Democrats and as decent human beings,” **said Asian American Action Fund Chair Albert Shen.**“We will not stand idly by while our communities are targeted and vilified.”**

Furthermore, Weiss’s continued refusal to engage with Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) press speaks volumes about her disregard and disrespect for a crucial segment of the electorate, which has proven to be a decisive swing vote in this area. This disdainful attitude towards AAPI media outlets raises serious doubts about Weiss' ability to authentically represent the diverse constituents of the 47th District.

The Korea Daily endorsement comes only days after Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) leaders voiced their [outrage over a political mailer](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=498dc13c15&e=7017cc100e) funded by a dark money PAC supporting Joanna Weiss for its racist undertones and attempts to discredit Min's integrity. The mailer’s use of a yellow tint and a money suit appears to paint an established Asian American lawmaker as a perpetual foreigner, unable to be trusted, and is reminiscent of the darkest chapters of discrimination in our nation's past.

“**Using yellow-tinted photos and depicting him in a money suit is not just racist, it's an insult to our community. These tactics will backfire with the 20% AAPI voters who live in his district,”** said Congressmember Grace Meng, Chair of the Asian and Pacific Islander Congressional Caucus’ Political Action Committee ASPIRE PAC**. **

Min is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, as well as the California Democratic Party, Service Employees International Union (SEIU), the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, California Environmental Voters, and over 150 local, state, and federal officials. Min is the unanimous choice of organized labor in this race, as he is the only candidate to receive support from national, statewide, and local unions, and he is the only candidate endorsed in this race by the California Labor Federation or the AFL-CIO. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=11acb09eb2&e=7017cc100e). ### _California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

clean_body: | | | | | | | For Immediate Release: March 4, 2024 Contact:mailto:press@davemin.com Dave Min Endorsed by The Korea Daily IRVINE, CA — Dave Min's campaign for Congress proudly announces the endorsement of The Korea Daily, one of the largest and most influential Korean-language newspapers in the United States. The 47th District, home to a substantial Korean community, relies on leaders who understand and champion the unique needs of its residents. This endorsement not only validates Min's commitment to representing diverse voices but also underscores his dedication to fighting for the rights and dignity of all constituents in California's 47th Congressional District. Weiss' campaign has a troubling history of resorting to divisive and racially charged rhetoric, raising serious concerns about her ability to properly represent the sizable AAPI community in Orange County. on January 29, 2024, members and leaders in the AAPI community in Orange County expressed frustration over Weiss' campaign tactics, stating: “We are tired of so-called allies in anti-racism resorting to the language of ‘othering’ to discredit fellow Democrats.” “Let me be clear: these tactics are not only repugnant but also an affront to everything we stand for as Democrats and as decent human beings,” said Asian American Action Fund Chair Albert Shen.“We will not stand idly by while our communities are targeted and vilified.” Furthermore, Weiss’s continued refusal to engage with Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) press speaks volumes about her disregard and disrespect for a crucial segment of the electorate, which has proven to be a decisive swing vote in this area. This disdainful attitude towards AAPI media outlets raises serious doubts about Weiss' ability to authentically represent the diverse constituents of the 47th District. The Korea Daily endorsement comes only days after Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) leaders voiced their funded by a dark money PAC supporting Joanna Weiss for its racist undertones and attempts to discredit Min's integrity. The mailer’s use of a yellow tint and a money suit appears to paint an established Asian American lawmaker as a perpetual foreigner, unable to be trusted, and is reminiscent of the darkest chapters of discrimination in our nation's past. “Using yellow-tinted photos and depicting him in a money suit is not just racist, it's an insult to our community. These tactics will backfire with the 20% AAPI voters who live in his district,” said Congressmember Grace Meng, Chair of the Asian and Pacific Islander Congressional Caucus’ Political Action Committee ASPIRE PAC. Min is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, as well as the California Democratic Party, Service Employees International Union (SEIU), the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, California Environmental Voters, and over 150 local, state, and federal officials. Min is the unanimous choice of organized labor in this race, as he is the only candidate to receive support from national, statewide, and local unions, and he is the only candidate endorsed in this race by the California Labor Federation or the AFL-CIO. A full endorsement list is available . ### California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. | | Our mailing address is: PO Box 5959, Irvine, CA 92616 | This email was sent to mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com Dave Min For Senate PO Box 5959 Irvine, CA 92616-5959 * USA

body:
We have an excellent chance to FLIP seven seats in this coming election. We only need to take TWO to take the Majority. Let’s take all seven and build a Majority that holds for a decade. | **West Virginia**
**Montana**
**Ohio**
**Pennsylvania**
**Arizona**
**Nevada**
**Wisconsin**

It has been a long time since we’ve had a chance like this, Fellow American.

**We can take back the majority and build one so strong it stands for ten years or longer!** Can you imagine that? Ten years of Republicans running the Senate and accomplishing incredible things.

[**These seven seats are CRITICAL for our efforts. If we fail and don’t flip at least two of these seats, we could be doomed to ten years of a Democrat Majority in the U.S. Senate.**](http://links.teamnrsc.co/u/click?_t=aff6d619248e4524b6f468bb9c83f15c&_m=557f043db09142859c558090c71c97e0&_e=SMGr4WZMeTwVxXfBq823SXMHZI5MDNhn7BpMkmaaPHpo829bznKJR7H3kgAgZU6rFHCoWhqgIDTqll865GeZAucL5QsZ4oymXBNUvwa5faFoNKrimg4rvxRjdr1GwwAPrDL6Vyt_XU1jxnCKcwAienm26vKmKiqPvOP_AjsiSiaNXeYH_RY8Yuoc3rBx_3C6S7Jhlhnls5NJBop03GVtyI_cjg6ok3APpiwtCKMSfVGlAP14r3VYcebos4z0Dq4bJ9ufFot7dNEZZ3BoGTgsqzklTShH4ON3apSSqoxAwEG-7azPB_LwHrqQ4uPf3fCYS7AOm9NMxvKBdmW-6vuxn8TJGUmZ1ctKutR_HOZ6qUa1_tZPUUYl30iOiTXZ9LKJVyjnM4-Xn4kaQLy10gIJSJE1OCLehZS7TsFbYnJamaU%3D)

That would be a horrible development. We have seen what Democrats do with power in the last four years, and we can’t risk more of their failed ideas and dangerous agenda. Our country’s future is on the line.

Future generations are counting on us to stand up to their insanity NOW before we are living in a country decimated by open borders amnesty, barely scraping by as inflation rises to astronomical proportions, our 2nd amendment rights are in tatters, and our military is weakened by Democrats refusing to raise our troops pay.

Candidates come forward to challenge Stefanik in NY-21 **North County This Week| By JEFF CHUDZINSKI** [Published March 3, 2024](https://jillforcongress.com/index.php?option=com_acym&ctrl=fronturl&task=click&urlid=77&userid=5597&mailid=437) A Republican has declared their candidacy for the Congressional seat currently held by Congresswoman Elise Stefanik, possibly setting up a Republican primary in NY-21. Stefanik, who was first elected to her seat in 2014, is running for her sixth term to represent the North Country in the House of Representatives. Republican Jill Lochner recently launched her campaign to challenge Stefanik, saying the U.S. political culture "has broken in meaningful ways" on her campaign page. "I have witnessed our leadership lose their moral compass to their own political ambitions and partisanship. As a lifelong Republican, it's painfully clear our party needs to correct the course not only for the best of our great democracy but for our Nation," she said. Lochner said he has "always been a true Republican" who believes in fiscal responsibility, limited government, upholding constitutional liberties, equal rights for all and conserving "America the Beautiful." "I am running for Congress because I can no longer sit back and accept the conspiracy theories, bigotry, and hateful ideologies that dominate the news. This is not what the people want. This is not what America is," she said. Lochner says she is not a politician but rather a wife, mother, daughter and New Yorker. "I want a future for our children, for our country, and for our Republican party. I can represent you because I am one of you," she said. Lochner was born and raised in Central New York to parents who owned and operated a fishing guide service, bed and breakfast and tackle shop. She attended Nazareth College in Rochester where she earned a Master's degree in Educational Technology and is New York State certified in Elementary and Special Education. Following her education, Lochner said she moved to New York City and "began a career helping the government to better serve people." "Throughout my life, whether I was in Central NY, Western NY, or downstate, I always found myself traveling to the North Country on weekends. Eleven years ago, when it was time to start a family, we returned home to the beautiful landscapes, values, and people of upstate. Through our own hard work and sacrifice, my husband and I built our homestead in the foothills of the Adirondacks," she said. Lochner said she wants to show fiscal responsibility through necessary budget reforms "to revive our economy and put us on a path to growth." According to Lochner, she also supports responsible firearm ownership. "The Second Amendment is not second class, it is a safeguard created by our founders to protect all other rights. Along with the majority of Americans, of gun owners, and of NRA members, I support a fast, efficient, and accurate universal background system to keep guns away from people with mental health issues. As a defender of the 2nd amendment, I would also legislate safeguards such as expedited redress and prohibitions against registries," she said. Lochner said she is also in favor of women being afforded the opportunity to make reproductive choices themselves. "The government should stay out of our bodies and out of our homes. Decisions should be made between a woman and her doctor," she said. Derek — it all
comes down to tomorrow.

We have all put in the work. We have all knocked on doors, made calls, and
talked with our families and friends across California. We have donated
and volunteered. We have made our case for the primary on March 5.

And yet, tomorrow, everything we have worked for is at stake. And more
than just California’s next U.S. Senator.

Donald Trump can virtually clinch the GOP presidential nomination tomorrow
— Super Tuesday — and we are going to have to work harder than ever to
protect our democracy in the future.

No matter the outcome tomorrow, we’ll have to fight.

We’ll have to fight for abortion access in dozens of states. We’ll have to
fight to protect Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, and lower drug
prices. We’ll have to fight for gun safety.

We’ll have to fight for our planet. We’ll have to fight to keep
corporations from getting away with paying $0 in federal taxes. We’ll have
to fight for LGBTQ+ equality, personal freedom, and an economy that works
for everyone.

We’ll have to fight for our democracy. And we’ll have to fight to protect
free and fair elections. Not just this fall, but potentially for years and
years to come.

We have to prepare now — we hope — for the general election that will
begin the second polls close tomorrow night.

Donald Trump and the MAGA movement will no doubt be emboldened by the
largest slate of Trump primary victories yet.

The wealthiest Americans and largest corporations will cut more checks for
Trump. The biggest polluters and oil companies will renew their support
for the GOP. The gun companies will further embrace the far right.

The most extreme right-wing MAGA Republicans in Congress and the media
will have larger platforms. Big Pharma will prepare for greater windfall
profits. Extremists fighting to take away personal freedoms will have an
unapologetic ally on the GOP ticket.

These are the stakes of the fight beyond Tuesday. We have to prepare.
Today.

That’s why I’m reaching out to you now, on the eve of our final Los
Angeles rally tonight. Because no matter what happens in the primary, our
work is far from done.

For nearly a decade, I’ve been helping to lead the charge to protect our
democracy from would-be autocrats. I’ve been helping lead the charge to
fight climate change and build an economy that works for everyone.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=mar2024_abs_em.AiZCIe&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240304_PM4_V2_S1&email=&t=1029&akid=5782%2E5257348%2E1aqS3r ]And I’m not done. Far from it.

I hope that I’ve earned your support. I hope that I’ve earned your vote.
And I hope that I’ve earned your trust. Because the next eight months will
be incredibly tough, and I’m ready for that fight too.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=mar2024_abs_em.YceVvx&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240304_PM4_V2_S1&email=&amount=3&t=1030&akid=5782%2E5257348%2E1aqS3r ]Derek, your donation can still have an impact. Chip in

We’ll have to fight for LGBTQ+ equality, personal freedom, and an economy that works for everyone. We’ll have to fight for our democracy. And we’ll have to fight to protect free and fair elections. Not just this fall, but potentially for years and years to come. We have to prepare now — we hope — for the general election that will begin the second polls close tomorrow night. Donald Trump and the MAGA movement will no doubt be emboldened by the largest slate of Trump primary victories yet. The wealthiest Americans and largest corporations will cut more checks for Trump. The biggest polluters and oil companies will renew their support for the GOP. The gun companies will further embrace the far right. The most extreme right-wing MAGA Republicans in Congress and the media will have larger platforms. Big Pharma will prepare for greater windfall profits. Extremists fighting to take away personal freedoms will have an unapologetic ally on the GOP ticket. These are the stakes of the fight beyond Tuesday. We have to prepare. Today. That’s why I’m reaching out to you now, on the eve of our final Los Angeles rally tonight. Because no matter what happens in the primary, our work is far from done. For nearly a decade, I’ve been helping to lead the charge to protect our democracy from would-be autocrats. What are your priorities, folks? Here are a few of mine:
* **Protecting reproductive rights.** I am co-sponsoring legislation to protect IVF under federal law after the conservative Alabama State Supreme Court essentially banned it in the state. Republicans will only ramp up their attacks on reproductive rights, and we must act urgently to support Americans who need IVF to build a family.
* **Championing free and fair elections**. I am calling on President Biden to include funding in the federal budget to help bring on and train new election officials and poll workers and provide security for these critical workers after so many have faced threats to their safety.
* **Stopping MAGA extremism.** I’m fighting every day to deliver common-sense solutions, keep our government open to work for the people, and block far-right policies that get in the way of our progress.

**[I hope you’ll take a few minutes to share what’s on your mind. Will you fill out my team’s March Priorities Survey today? Your responses will help guide our campaign strategy in the months ahead.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80309257/459013526/1643274824?refcode=AU_MTH_EG_GEN_SUR_AC_20240304_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMDA5ZjM2MS05OGRhLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QzvPV-BoJkakdqd-yS08Hf6FFBPd_Qwc50GrpYkLj4E=&emci=2c09f361-98da-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=3009f361-98da-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=252045)** | [TAKE THE SURVEY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80309258/459013527/1643274824?refcode=AU_MTH_EG_GEN_SUR_AC_20240304_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMDA5ZjM2MS05OGRhLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QzvPV-BoJkakdqd-yS08Hf6FFBPd_Qwc50GrpYkLj4E=&emci=2c09f361-98da-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=3009f361-98da-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=252045)

I spent most of the day today in Blairstown, NJ at Blair Academy, a private co-educational high school that I attended before matriculating to Yale. I had the opportunity to attend an economics class, address the entire school community, have lunch with faculty and administrators, and join a Freshman English class. I can honestly say it was among the most energizing days I've had in a while. The students were curious, engaged, and clearly motivated to understand different perspectives, and the faculty were open-minded, caring, and more thoughtful than many of my former colleagues at Harvard and Yale. Please the article below about my visit that was posted on the school's website.
Blair Academy, Blairstown, NJ
* * *
### **[Dr. Vikram Mansharamani: A Generalist's Journey](https://substack.com/redirect/d45eb66b-f9fd-4824-97be-33e61caae518?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
** _written by Adele Starrs_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b62a824a-8ce4-4641-b744-cede55cb8f73?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Even at 16 years old, _**Vikram Mansharamani '92**_ stood out. The intrepid Blair junior possessed a wide-ranging curiosity that led him to pursue a variety of interests and activities, and in the spring of 1991, Vikram decided it was time to follow his passion for investing. So he wrote to founder of The Vanguard Group, fellow Blair alum _**Jack Bogle '47**_, asking about available internships. Mr. Bogle graciously connected Vikram with _**Mitch Jennings Jr. '63**_, a fellow Blair alum and executive at Bear Stearns, and from there, Vikram's journey took flight.
Vikram showed up at 245 Park Avenue in Manhattan that summer and found that his talents and the connections he made would soon lead him from moving boxes in the stock room to the bustling equity trading floor of Wall Street. In a few years, the gifted student would find his way to Yale University, where he earned his bachelor's degree, and, later, to the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, where he earned two master's degrees and a PhD.
Today, Vikram has carved a niche for himself at the forefront of multiple industries, embracing his role as a "generalist." An entrepreneur, economist and scholar, he was a lecturer at the Harvard John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences and writes a weekly column (available at _[mansharamani.substack.com](https://substack.com/redirect/971065cb-4fb0-4503-8928-4ea898cc2dd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_). The bestselling author of titles like _Boombustology: Spotting Financial Bubbles Before They Burst_ , Vikram's insights have appeared in Bloomberg, Fortune, Forbes and others. Notably, LinkedIn.com has twice named Dr. Mansharamani their #1 top voice on the topics of money, finance and global economics. _Worth_ magazine listed him as one of the 100 Most Powerful People in Global Finance. And In 2022, he ventured into politics, becoming a candidate for one of New Hampshire's seats in the United States Senate.
This week, Vikram returned to Blair, sharing his journey from a working-class immigrant household to becoming a student at Blair, and ultimately, a leading voice in American business, government, academia and journalism.
During School Meeting on March 4, Vikram joined English teacher Bob Brandwood, who coached Vikram in swimming at Blair, to share his insights about the importance of curiosity, broad-minded thinking and the benefits of being a generalist. "You will all face pressure to specialize-to get narrow and to develop an expertise-because that will be seen as the basis to differentiate yourself." The benefit of rethinking that framework, Vikram noted, is that "Specialists don't see the full context of their decisions," drawing an analogy to the limitations of having only one tool in a toolbox. "You see the world differently when you look through different lenses," he advised, encouraging students to gather multiple tools. "We need to keep experts on tap, not on top. Integrating multiple insights-that will emerge to be your true competitive advantage."
Throughout the day, Vikram engaged in more in-depth discussions with classes and left students with a piece of advice that resonated: "Blair is an amazing place to explore and get to know your peers and faculty...where one can do eclectic, fun things and not feel guilty about it. That's a luxury. Use that curiosity to its full advantage here at Blair." Vikram generously provided Blair students and faculty with copies of his book _The Making of a Generalist: An Independent Thinker Finds Unconventional Success in an Uncertain World_ , in which he expands upon the message shared in the all-school assembly.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsVrBUPiN5

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osVrBUPiN5

Dear
,
If you
opened this email because you remember my playing days with the
Dodgers and the Padres, thank you.

Having
you and all of America's baseball fans cheering for me and Davey
Lopes, Bill Russell, Ron Cey and the rest of the guys as we
battled Reggie Jackson, Thurman Munson and the Yankees...
...well,
as they say, "Those were the days."
But this
email isn't about baseball. In fact, it's a email I never thought
I'd be writing to you.

Today,
I'm asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a
seat in the United States Senate.
Today,
I'm asking you to help me start a Republican Comeback Rally that
folks will be talking about for generations to come.
Because
when you think about it, those 'good-ol' days of the 1970s
weren't as good as we tend to first remember.
Baseball
was just a welcome distraction from the gloom and malaise that
had settled on our country thanks to one failed Democrat policy
after another.
I'm
running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is
starting to look a lot like 1970s America.
You
remember what it was like:
- Not
only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could
only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license
plate numbers. Remember?
- Eleven
Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in
Munich by terrorists. Remember?
-
Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists
in Iran. Remember??
Democrat
policies had brought America to its knees.
And now,
as Yogi Berra used to say, "It's déjà vu all over again."
There's
fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime,
homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding
and for the first time causing more people to leave California.
Joe
Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one
bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to
say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and
dependent.
And I
wouldn't blame you if you said, "Steve, I'm afraid America's best
days are behind us."
But
listen, here's something I also want you to remember...
We
Republicans pulled our country out of that 1970's Democratic
malaise by electing Ronald Reagan.
We put
classic conservative values at the heart of everything we did.
And
America became a shining city upon a hill once more.
We can do
that again.
It starts
by stunning the Democrats with a Senate win in California.
But
there's no way I can pull it off without you.
That's
why I'm asking you to rush in your $35 donation today
I'm sorry
for the urgency but the primary is in less than three months and
here's where things stand...
In March,
I need to be one of the top 2 vote-getters to get to the November
general election.
Adam
Schiff will probably take the #1 spot. And polls have me hot on
his heels for the #2 spot.
Once
we're passed the primary, I know with your help, I can beat him
in November.
Why?
First...
I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can
tell you -- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've
never seen before.
They are
hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters
in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of
California...
I know we
can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win.
Second...
you know I'm not a career politician.
But I do
have the one thing a Republican needs to get elected in
California...
...name
recognition.
I'm no
Schwarzenegger and I'd certainly never dare compare myself to
President Reagan.
But
California voters know me.
And Adam
Schiff and the Democrats are shaking in their boots seeing how
quickly I rose in the polls after entering the race.
As I'm
writing you this email, there are just a few percentage points
separating us.
We've got
a shot -- a very real shot -- of landing smack behind Schiff in
the primary so we can go on to beat him in the general election.
But there
are just three months left until the primary.
And the
giant Democrat political machine is going to use every second of
that time trying to bury me and our common sense message.
When you
rush back your Garvey for Senate campaign contribution of $35 or
more...
...you're
helping fund ads, appearances, events, fliers, door knockers,
EVERYTHING that blankets California with the message:
You don't
have to accept failed Democrat policies that make all of us less
safe, less prosperous, and less free.
This race
is the toughest in the nation.
But they
say the hardest thing to do in sports is hit a 95-mph fastball.
And you
know I've done that plenty of times.
Now I'm
ready to do the hardest thing in American politics -- win in
California as a common sense Republican.
But I
can't do it without you.
I'm
fighting for the soul of the state I love -- but make no mistake
-- I'm not just taking the field for Californians.
When we
win here... when we rip this seat out the hands of the radical
Adam Schiff...
...we
start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country
desperately needs.
It all
depends on you!
You can
do nothing and continue to suffer the agony of defeat. Or you can
step up to the plate with me and take a swing for the thrill of
victory. Please join me. Because when we win in California, we're
winning for all of America.
Thank you
and God Bless,

Steve
Garvey

Republican for United States Senate

P.S. It's
the bottom of the 9th and Republicans desperately need a homerun.
We simply can't let another election slip through our fingers
while Democrats go on destroying our country. With your help, I
know we can beat Adam Schiff in California and start the
Republican Comeback Rally America needs. But the primary is in
just three months. So please rush campaign contribution of $35 or
more as soon as you can. Thank you! -Steve

DONATE

PAID FOR
BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U.S. SENATE

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Share the message of Jesus this Easter
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsBDZRPiwN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osBDZRPiwN

Hello
Friend,

The cross
of Jesus Christ stands at the center of our faith. It is the
symbol not just of a religion but of the ultimate sacrifice and
love displayed by Jesus Christ for humanity.

The cross
stands as a reminder of the immense love of God, who sent His
only Son to bear the burden of our sins. Through His sacrifice,
Jesus provided a path to redemption and eternal life for all who
believe in Him.

In
moments of hardship and uncertainty, we, as believers, can find
strength in the shadow of the cross. It stands as a promise of
salvation and the assurance of God's unfailing grace.

The power
of the cross lies in its ability to transform lives and reconcile
humanity with God. It is the ultimate symbol of victory-victory
over sin and death. It offers forgiveness and restoration to all
who embrace its message.

This
beautiful full-color 96-page large print "coffee-table style"
book is filled with imagery from the Holy Land as well as
photographic depictions of key Scriptural events. It can be used
as a daily devotional or as a timeless reference resource about
the events of Jesus' final week on earth.

A copy of
The Power of the Cross is our gift to anyone who supports the
ministry of Pathway to Victory. By making a secure, generous
donation to our work of evangelism and Bible teaching, you are
helping many people around the world experience the power of the
cross and its message of hope and forgiveness.

Please consider
supporting our mission of helping people know Jesus and
understand the Bible. If you can help, here is a link to make
your secure donation and order your copy of The Power of the
Cross: https://secure.ptv.org/the_power_of_the_cross

Our time for sharing
the message of Jesus and the power of the cross grows shorter
every day.

Let's make the most
of it by partnering together!

Sincerely,

Dr. Robert Jeffress
Senior Pastor, First
Baptist Dallas

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z9p8t04a7t8j2lo9opu4b3povfe7am93lrgrah3o_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sdim8p71c9h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zl1qv2daq5m4g7gjeofblha4q3a2gslnvkt9saio_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sdim8p71c9h2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zp8qt2p020jmnp7tsuqiu58gnpbvgr1mkl0rq4m8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sdim8p71c9h2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: The Babylon Bee
subject: The battle for free speech is going to the Supreme court
body:
One of the most important free speech cases of our time is going before the Supreme Court

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zcarakb1kj2fbhiog1bajp0hrd0hk63oetfo4pi8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sdim4p75chh2bs)
---
|
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zt65u91fs2l9nflp2mrbu4r4idnuapdvsgujnuvg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sdim4p75chh2bs)
---
**One of the most important free speech cases of our time is going before the Supreme Court, and you probably haven’t heard about it.** Right now, both Texas and Florida are battling to uphold their common-sense bills that prohibit viewpoint discrimination on social media. These bills were passed for a reason — conservative voices are being suppressed. Disfavored opinions (and even jokes) that are out of step with the progressive narrative have resulted in countless violations and suspensions. And that’s not an exaggeration; we’ve experienced many cases of discriminatory censorship firsthand. In fact, we were locked out of Twitter for 8 months just because we told a joke that referred to a male person (“Admiral” Rachel Levine) as a man. It’s gotten completely out of hand. Thankfully, Texas and Florida decided to do something about it. They drafted and passed legislation that would make it unlawful for big social media companies to engage in viewpoint discrimination. But, as expected, the social media companies challenged these laws, leading to an upcoming showdown at the Supreme Court. What the highest Court decides here will have far-reaching implications not just for us, but for everyone who uses social media to share their views and defend their values. **_That’s why Babylon Bee has filed an amicus brief in support of the Florida and Texas laws._**
---
[Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z6uitc5lj5lnbm0jglnnv5lq64k2oj8rfc2n0r70_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sdim4p75chh2bs)
---
This is nothing new for us. We’ve long been committed to defending free speech in the public square. Here are some of the free speech battles we’ve taken on over the years:
* We filed an amicus brief with the U.S. Supreme Court in support of a humorist who was actually jailed because of a parody Facebook page.
* We sued the Attorney General's Office in the state of California to block the enforcement of a law requiring social media companies to regularly report "misinformation, disinformation, extremism, radicalization, and hate speech."
* We sued the New York Attorney General too, for the same censorship debauchery.
* We refused to delete a tweet that resulted in the suspension of our Twitter account with over 1 million followers
* We told Mark Zuckerberg he sucks

Fighting on the front lines for free speech in the public square isn’t easy or inexpensive, but it’s the right thing to do. And it’s making a difference. But we can’t do it without you. **[**Will you become a paid subscriber to The Babylon Bee to help us stay in the fight?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zf7qa6akikhvpafajmadko9jtf9qmva4r5fpg08o_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sdim4p75chh2bs)**

subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/7-KniuZRmDZQfFieTT8E5Q~~/AARclAA~~~) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/7-KniuZRmDZQfFieTT8E5Q~~/AARclAA~~~)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/7-KniuZRmDZQfFieTT8E5Q~~/AARclAA~~~)** Thank you for your time and attention. ## Supreme Court Rules 9-0 For Trump
The U.S. Supreme Court struck down a Colorado Supreme Court decision Monday and [unanimously ruled](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1yszAQAJ8GOjHiJIwpKL6Gzl-bkhHSyb6M0BH9mPjtM06ddrfZ2Y_bejMUKN7_mx3n4nk1ttATVyUGAXrVrZs9IqBqce5HOV30pBS0j3nbjByGfpTaTVaBB2_11V37yY96AuNbmkGClkoOvRwu0HfjVYEZRrVpN_Zabo2W6Khw6j6ZYnmgDy9-Yuos722YH6UcuVH_GlgaWM7z7Dx_Rzzz2zewHByokM0NLLkeCXcUlmsqItWAWdRoIu1cc3gJz0mUVPdDUBSWAyfjWGwmBC7CUf6qJpAnawpxfIOjFmzT7I6TQqB8GRst77uh8NtW_hr1EwAA___V3G4r) that the state couldn't remove Former President Trump from its 2024 primary ballot. The Colorado court cited a [Civil War clause](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL_G3oiOOzBmYOiSLV07WhiOhAoHC5NE_fsqnTs-veXpfV2Wi88l36-ffmPXU1186PnJCwktUC1qjC4xI9PIThqwk7JEON7cvBo5TxYB2DBHCTQr1qw9zhCJ7JgdAiog0BL0hPJkZkKvDa0qGqlgHRRwzL2203fN937jVH7qk9sp1G0s7tb7fgz0MeB5wLPf7_w63uoNredQeMDz8dgbbyxCfbQuentsuwi11OZjFasvpXaBZCERgmLi4H2kMEmTbFwhJRuRx-bi_sql5GMyg4Lr5nP5i-j_HfkNAAD__4cqYME) in the 14th Amendment, meant to prevent Confederates from serving in government, as legal justification for Trump's removal and was followed by other states looking to stall Trump's candidacy. The Supreme Court ruled that Congress, not individual states, has the authority to enforce the 14th Amendment. House Democrat Jamie Raskin (D-MD) [expressed disappointment](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFutDAQhJ_GdEZm18Zc4eJv6O5vUyJjlru9GIyMOZK3j0idZjTSSDOa7-M-3D1HXh___UKuzGnwofCbBpRGgh50NbmZCAgrco1Vt1bfEKF6umA6QBUmq2yj27HrZhNu3puZcA44dhU7UKAVKtMo00JT2w7BG4ujnmyj1Si0oolLyvUr8VqeNMfv9KZch7RU0T1L2XaB_wT0AvrzPGv_xWm_UgH91S2gV3jJ5V5-YZLZ75-8ypKPZZOjjzEVmY_roNyPLdNCMqQjlyq7aTs5Rt5bK7R6LJ7j73D5i8JPAAAA__8gVF0-) in the Supreme Court and announced he was working on legislation to correct the decision. _" I'm working on it -- today,"_ Raskin said.
## Super Tuesday Preview
Today is [Super Tuesday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu8yAURp8Gb9eCC46TwcOfX_KWrh0tDNcxKQYEOG7evkrnTt8nneXofN6mm3behfuH3mioS5y0qe5Jk4QOUE2qscNChCQbGkTPLyd1kRKbdehJXEy3dNZygzif5Vl0sheotNRKLHPjBuSouOSd4N0JRdufJequl7OyvVB8ZoqTdTXm9hFdqCst_hWflFsTt8YPa62pMPmP4chwPI6j3Up4M4YjBdgLwzHQ8Z4UvavOvC99J69doAxrPKDsiTLUnYrVLzBx9xZmglV7ehXwulQwqw6GoEYoNSaoed8Sw1FnuF7F4yv-j00ebDqc966ceqb4fdPO_0rWv4r9BAAA__9eG243), the single most important voting day during the primary campaign season. Republican presidential candidates [Former President Trump and Nikki Haley](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71uhDAQBOCnsTsjszZwFC7S0F3alMg_y7GJwQj7zrq3j0idbqRvpNF83ee7pUj749NuaMqSZusLvXBWohOgZ82DWRABFUfTDnLs9agU8NU4VCj97WZH26ND8KPXbhxaLWWvsA2cDEjQUsmulV0PbTPcFNhuUE6Hq-aYlhiopLP5TrSXFZf4Ti88G582Hs1aypGZ-mAwMZhqrY13eceaL2cwXfGC1RZBWeTngacoT8zBvsWaqggJs6Aiajp_GEz8NOGoFCPlfmBaPjZL8W-r_Hf8NwAA__9hj1pG) are contending for 865 delegates, and President Biden can pick up 1,420 delegates. Current delegate counts have Trump with a commanding lead of 247 to Haley's 43. A candidate must collect 1,215 delegates to secure the GOP presidential nomination. President Biden has 206 and is unopposed. [See the current delegate map here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71yhCAUQOGngU4HLiC7BUUau02b0uHnut4ExUFmnX37jKlTn-Kb8_WYHp4ybc9Pv6Jrc5l8bPTCSXWmAz1pntyMCKg4OmnFfdB3pYAv7ibv0gphQrLWhyEZMBiSnmfrfUwSODkQoIUSRgozgOztTYE3VgWdrNQiMC0wUSu1_y60tQXn_C4vrH0sK89uaW0_mPpgMDIYz_PstxA3PI-rMxj3kqlRPBiMF9TtlVZf3x1mjI3KdoWEGZ--Ydeqjz9YeXVpPylnOgbLtHiunvKf1_6b_w0AAP__oRpblQ). President Trump is perceived by many as the GOP presumptive nominee, but still needs an [additional 971 delegates](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQAL_G7oiWZQ1xQXFNulx7pbU264QIGwtIovz9Ka9-5Wia0fy7TleOKe63v7yJb2ueeGnxJZNRg0KaqA9-FUExvXjtYLQ0GoP93aNdXXCOAZCJReOZIYyOzqMF0uvcR4-ABAYGDYNFfXJngzw4M1NwmmDuCCTElsvpkePe7rKmT35JOS1565O_t3bUzvzp8NLhhY9d3vWrvlBaXJJ0eKnPQ4pqT6mBPypIkhs3qarI8ZxTXHhXQba8FG5VbfzIJbaPgjBYjasRHYRGB6SJIMyjFqDFzqEvPhzvmFKs1nUEt41j-slqvz36HwAA__8FGGdG). ## Bitcoin Nears All-Time High

body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=934738e63f844cf5b0c40b5cb4044a12&_e=7nJ6ogVO-i2QugmwGGzkzqnKMSjBvBqHTcfm7K11n6jFioVoCLV_e5S5PqbpxBgV4JVob8TfyQs8dpxp9NvKJ6p3aTlcchkJCnUnOP9odc-iEEbQKMUxwd-nlwjQ9NTwRdwldQiqcgEdPJjdMKeDq-9SAkxZpyWJmF5fTf7tCAwbuC875TiYhJaAnoOYbMrbihac9wGui6y3vbpJ-02mhYhXRprNjCw-7rgRnFqRvIFEL0exSeVFYwiT29gv2W-wT-WlTmvReV5RzR4KdbyWDSHBKuxguXCrFCjMbj9t9kap8wnYOQ3R1hq3RmocBWDsxCcdZHsRkXqcLuFu8CQxD14bvhFkY6DspMnZHWElC6u0e0OylDiMM48VvU-dKqkPrkY4sd-9KGLsS3T5mQUrkw%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: crashing Biden’s State of the Union
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Media elites are already cheerleading for President Joe Biden to hammer abortion during his _State of the Union_ on Thursday.

Speculation is everywhere that the President is bringing a special presidential “guest” — someone that proves the “need” to impose abortion throughout all nine months of a pregnancy.

Well, Pro-Life Friend, I’m about to crash President Biden’s pro-abortion party — _if I can count on your help._

You see, I just got off the phone with U.S. Rep. Bob Good (R-VA), one of our strongest allies on Capitol Hill, who told me he wants to bring a special guest of his own — Ryan Bomberger.

Ryan has agreed! And I can tell you Ryan’s presence is SURE to send media heads spinning!

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-skrakl-duchtdja-y/)
Now, I just need to pay for his flights and lodging to make it all happen.

**[So, can I count on you to please make your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ immediately](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-skrakl-duchtdja-j/)?**

If you’re not familiar with Ryan, he was conceived in rape.

Thankfully his mother chose life and placed him with a loving, adoptive family. And now Ryan is pro-life activist, husband and father of 4, and a powerful speaker.

In fact, he’s agreed to come along for my **_“NO ABORTION, NO EXCEPTIONS!”_** Campus Speaking Tour.

Ryan’s story makes the heads of people explode who believe America needs abortion.

I can’t wait to hear media elites arguing how Ryan doesn’t deserve to live because they can’t think of any other way to dismiss his story.

**The truth is, every human being is valuable.**

And every little baby would be loved if they were just given a chance to live.

Ryan’s attendance at the _State of the Union_ will be a powerful statement by the pro-life movement — which is what we need.

We need to PROVE to every Member of Congress that we’re serious and we’re not going away.

We can do that — if I can count on your help to get Ryan to the _State of the Union!_

**[Can you please agree to a generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or $25 to help pay for Ryan’s flights and lodging](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-skrakl-duchtdja-i/)?**

Let’s crash President Biden’s pro-abortion _State of the Union!_

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

name: David Hogg, Leaders We Deserve
subject: Hey Peter, can I get minute of your time today for something important?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action PAC
body:
I'm deeply worried...
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te7fce56c-0d1b-4848-be47-0c6050f73273/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
|
---
| |
---
| | | Hey, Peter, thanks for opening this email. I know a lot is going on, so I appreciate it. It’s a little long, but it’s from the heart, and it’s important. You don’t have to be obsessed with politics or watching the news 24/7 to know our country is in a bad place. Horrific violence in the Middle East. A Republican Party that has gone so far off the rails they could barely elect a Speaker. The leading Republican candidate for president is Donald Trump! And then we have unspeakable atrocities like the mass shooting in Maine because our “leaders” refuse to act. And many people talk about how Trump is a major threat to democracy and he is — but I believe there is an even greater and more long-term threat \- hopelessness. When I was knocking doors for Leaders We Deserve-endorsed candidate Nadarius Clark for the Virginia elections, the most concerning answer I got when I asked if people were voting was, “No, I don’t believe in voting” or “No all politics is corrupt and my vote doesn’t matter.” This scares me because things can never get better if we continue electing people who say “government doesn't work” who then get elected and make it not work. I’m deeply worried about us. And it’s not because I’m anti-America. It’s because I love this country and I desperately want to see us do better. We’re not going to fix this mess overnight. But we do have a plan. A group of us just launched Leaders We Deserve. We started it because we know that young progressive leaders can change the future of this country for the better by giving us what we need most to get through this moment of democratic backsliding, HOPE. We can elect more young leaders like Nadarius Clark, but we can ONLY do it if enough of us get behind them. For us to give the school shooting generation the hope it needs to secure the future of our democracy and build a more perfect union, we must get to work electing the next generation of morally just leaders who put kids first and the NRA out of business. The truth is that young progressive candidates who are running for office face huge barriers. The average age of our elected officials is astronomical. That’s because our election system favors those who are older, wealthy, and white. In 2020, Millennial and Gen-Z individuals only held 21% of State Legislative seats despite representing 45% of the electorate. We launched Leaders We Deserve specifically to coalesce support from millions of Americans who believe in the promise of this younger generation. Here’s our plan:
* Find young progressives who are willing to run for Congress and state legislatures.
* Equip their campaigns with messaging, scheduling, and budget tools they need to win.
* And most importantly, raise funds from our massive national network (hey, that’s you!) to allow them to go toe-to-toe with their opponents and WIN.

Peter, if we succeed, ten years from now we’ll have shifted the politics of this nation dramatically. Young, progressive leaders will make up their fair share of the legislative and congressional seats, allowing us to right the ship and build the future we deserve. But what we do right now will determine whether or not that vision comes to pass. We can’t just muddle along raising a couple hundred thousand dollars here and there. We’ll actually have to raise tens of millions of dollars from grassroots donors like you to get the breadth and scale we need to win in all corners of the country. Here’s what I need from you for our plan to work. – If you are blessed with the financial ability to make a really big donation (like $500 or more), please do so right now to help us make this vision a reality. [Click here if you are fortunate enough to give $500 or more.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5bd71cd1-9743-4002-a7ee-a8262a223181/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – If you can give a small donation each month, that makes a big impact too. [Click here if you think you can commit to a $25 monthly donation (or something like that).](https://default.salsalabs.org/T01f94949-8ccd-460d-96b7-a4217a79bc24/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – If you can’t give big and you can’t give monthly, that’s totally OK (most people can’t). [Click here to just give a one time donation of whatever you can afford.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf089cbe8-66b6-433f-a4c3-8ec208769830/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – Last but not least, if you can’t chip in at all, I completely understand. All I ask is that you forward this email to three friends who might be aligned with our cause. I hope this fundraiser is as successful as I know it can be. I hope that we look back at this moment in ten years and say THIS is when everything started to change. If you have any questions at all about Leaders We Deserve, please check out our website or get in touch with us on social media. From the bottom of my heart, thank you for reading today. \- David Hogg

In 2020, Millennial and Gen-Z individuals only held 21% of State Legislative seats despite representing 45% of the electorate. We launched Leaders We Deserve specifically to coalesce support from millions of Americans who believe in the promise of this younger generation. Here’s our plan: Find young progressives who are willing to run for Congress and state legislatures. Equip their campaigns with messaging, scheduling, and budget tools they need to win. And most importantly, raise funds from our massive national network (hey, that’s you!) to allow them to go toe-to-toe with their opponents and WIN. Peter, if we succeed, ten years from now we’ll have shifted the politics of this nation dramatically. Young, progressive leaders will make up their fair share of the legislative and congressional seats, allowing us to right the ship and build the future we deserve. But what we do right now will determine whether or not that vision comes to pass. We can’t just muddle along raising a couple hundred thousand dollars here and there. We’ll actually have to raise tens of millions of dollars from grassroots donors like you to get the breadth and scale we need to win in all corners of the country. Here’s what I need from you for our plan to work. – If you are blessed with the financial ability to make a really big donation (like $500 or more), please do so right now to help us make this vision a reality. – If you can give a small donation each month, that makes a big impact too. – If you can’t give big and you can’t give monthly, that’s totally OK (most people can’t). – Last but not least, if you can’t chip in at all, I completely understand. All I ask is that you forward this email to three friends who might be aligned with our cause. I hope this fundraiser is as successful as I know it can be. I hope that we look back at this moment in ten years and say THIS is when everything started to change. If you have any questions at all about Leaders We Deserve, please check out our website or get in touch with us on social media. # 9-0 VICTORY AT SCOTUS: American Rule of Law Holds Firm.
, The Supreme Court of the United States yesterday unanimously ruled that the effort to remove President Trump from the ballot by the States is unconstitutional - the rule of law prevails in America once again.
Other than yours truly, not a single candidate in this race for Congress has acknowledged or even mentioned the 9-0 upholding of the Constitution for our Republic. Let that sink in: those who want to swear to represent you on the Constitution **_won't even mention_** it being upheld unanimously today in a major victory for our nation from those hordes who sought to undermine it with over 30 lawsuits in states trying to remove President Trump from the ballot.
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=2e7e61cddc&e=5bb5efcda7) Democrat law professor Jonathan Turley of George Washington Law [said of today's ruling](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=b084cfe67b&e=5bb5efcda7): "The Court showed a divided nation that we remain bound by shared constitutional values,"...
**The attacks to remove President Trump from the ballot are some of the most egregious attacks on our Republic, and my opponents won't even speak of them. So much for defending our Constitution.**

Do you believe they will speak up for your rights in Congress, since they won't even do so when not yet there? Not when it matters when the heat is on them. But not so me. I will win in November as your next Congressman because I can win votes across the aisle. _Whether you are Republican, Democrat or Independent, you know one thing well - I will speak up and fight for you regardless of Party._
There is much to hope and work for as we campaign to win this seat to represent you well. __Please join me today and sign up to have a sign placed, volunteer, host a house party and contribute whatever you can.__

Thank you and God bless this land and our beautiful Constitution.

Freedom and Victory,

body:
With the House majority on the line, it’s important every single one of us steps up and supports true conservative candidates.

| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zn9lsk39h21s9idqkg99ai233t95261ppmq108i0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sdim9or2c5h2bs)

| | Friend, this is Bo Hines. ⬆️

He’s currently running in North Carolina’s newly drawn 6th Congressional District – and _**_[here’s why you should support him!](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zg8l2ob1gijgjnil1cae2p7u93tfu8g01l3dmre8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sdim9or2c5h2bs)_**_

Bo was a freshman All-American wide receiver at North Carolina State who then transferred to Yale, and received a law degree from Wake Forest School of Law, experiences he learned a great deal from.

His football career taught him the value of hard work, discipline, and resilience.

And his law degree? It provided him with the tools to read, write, and understand the law, something that’s a TRUE weapon in Washington. **If we can get Bo to Washington then far-Left snowflakes like AOC and the Squad can’t sneak their liberal wishlist items into bills and hope no one catches on... _because Bo will! _**
---
[**CHIP IN TO SUPPORT BO HINES!**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5t9r680pj10g7p8tk6pd27gernsd6o5jqjf12e8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sdim9or2c5h2bs)
---
| | But friend, what rounds Bo out as the **perfect fiscal conservative** is his business experience.

He runs multiple successful businesses in North Carolina. He has a deep understanding of what the American people – and North Carolinians in particular – want and need.

**After all, he’s seen the firsthand impacts of Bidenomics – on his family, his business, his neighbors, and his community. **

He’s seen families struggle to make ends meet. He’s watched as parents had to choose between putting food on the table or putting gas in their cars to get to work. [_**And he knows that the only way to FIX this mess is with fiscal conservatives leading the charge in Washington.**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5s5nr61oitlhgv347mjcl5hh1kfu963no6lj928_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sdim9or2c5h2bs)

---
[**YES! LET’S SEND BO TO WASHINGTON**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zq75pte2jtiepfnjkvk9k8j28sm18n8ukl7tf028_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sdim9or2c5h2bs)
---
Friend, Bo would be a _voice for small business owners and job creators_ because he has personal experience dealing with burdensome government regulations.

When he attempted to grow his business, he faced Big Government red tape that prevented him from investing in his neighbors and community at a time when they _desperately_ needed it. **This experience is what fuels his passion and fight for small-town America. **

**Friend, grassroots conservatives are coming together to rally behind Bo in this 6-way Republican Primary.____[__Can we count on you to help us send Bo to victory? ___ _](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zsghg1ei6acjegq8lpftd5gus2ri0gsug3bo2ff8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sdim9or2c5h2bs)__**

[**SUPPORT conservative CANDIDATE BO HINES**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvho8a2bhlcn2fk9rqmu50rnanup04tnbskeukv0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sdim9or2c5h2bs)

name: Nikki Haley
subject: Super Tuesday is HERE.
body:
Are you ready?

| |
---
| | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30365%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8oxe3vY8%2f6kfo6M9InP3jQ&sysid=1)
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30365%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8oxe3vY8%2f6kfo6M9InP3jQ&sysid=1)
---

Friend,

Over the last year, we’ve pounded the pavement, shared my message, shook every hand, answered every question, and left no stone left unturned.

**NOW, a day we’ve all worked so hard for is here - Super Tuesday!**

_Are you ready?_

Polls are open in states across the country, and we’re fighting for every vote.

Today, voters will have a choice to elect a new generational leader and move on from the drama and chaos of the past.

They will have a choice to elect a leader who can **DEFEAT** Joe Biden in November and right the ship to save our country.

**[Will you chip in and join me in this fight today?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30366%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2by8IlNjozP6RmhzmQ%2f4npg&sysid=1 "Will you chip in and join
me in this fight today?")**

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30365%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8oxe3vY8%2f6kfo6M9InP3jQ&sysid=1)
---

Since day one of this campaign, I’ve listened to the American people--not the political class.

_And I can tell you_ , Americans across the country believe we can do so much better--that we must do better.

And they know when our country’s future is on the line, you fight harder than ever.

That’s why my team and I will be out in full force today making a crucial push to reach voters, make phone calls, knock doors, and get the vote out before the polls close tonight... but we cannot do it alone.

_We need**YOU** to join us during this critical stretch. _

**[Can I count on support from you right now?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30367%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LhMackgM%2b20HXHQNRzAlEQ&sysid=1 "Can I count on support
from you right now?")**

---
| | [DONATE](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30368%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZSzI%2b6pdnB1Y%2bzZlofWKxg&sysid=1)
---

We are fighting for every inch because we have a country to save.

We can live in a world where we strongly disagree without hating each other.

We can live in a world where our kids aren't worried about how they'll get a job or if they'll ever be able to own a home.

We can live in a world where we restore normalcy and move on from the chaos of the past.

I’m willing to take the cuts, the bruises, and the name calling.

But I need you on my side every step of the way.

**[Will you chip in $10 or more TODAY?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30369%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=MY0EALNQM2%2bKAFyGfFkbUw&sysid=1 "Will you chip in $10 or
more TODAY?")**

Please join us now...before it is too late.

You can help determine the outcome of this race and our country’s future.

Thank you in advance.

**Let’s do this!**
---

My very best,

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.
