This is what we’ve been working towards! | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/65f35d0ce879/a-new-way-forward-for-texas-12683317?e=b8ba94fd9b)
---
If elected, I’ll be one of the youngest U.S. Senators in our country’s history, and the first Black U.S. Senator from Texas.
But this race was never about me.
It was about breaking the status quo. It was about putting everyday Texans above everyday politicians.It was about creating A New Way Forward.
**Whatever happens today, I’m proud of how we have campaigned over the last 9 months. And I’m so proud to have had you by my side.**
Whether you were with us from day 1, or you just joined Team Tchenko this week, _thank you._ You are what keeps me going.
I’ve visited scores of Texas counties throughout this race, driving over 30,000 miles since launching this campaign.
I’ve met thousands of amazing people across the great state of Texas.
We put forward the Rural Bill of Rights.
We garnered support from a diverse group of Texans, rural, urban and suburban, Black, white and brown, young and old....
We hosted weekly Tuesdays with Tchenko, because everyone deserves access to their Senators, not just those with deep pockets. [**(Speaking of which, want to join me today at 3pm to ask me any final questions? Join me at TuesdaysWithTchenko.com.)**](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=bc6ce3282c&e=b8ba94fd9b)
**Together, we have shown that A New Way Forward is possible.**
Make sure to have your voice heard today in this important election. And be sure to invite 3 friends to join you in voting today. Because the only thing that will save our democracy, is us. We have to show up and do the work.
Team Tchenko has been doing that.
**And I couldn’t be prouder to be standing with you heading into Election Day.**
Thank you,Thierry Democratic Candidate for U.S. Senate

There’s a palpable feeling in the air
We stand, again, on the precipice of important judicial decisions regarding democracy and women’s rights to healthcare. When our opponents want to take us back, your contributions move us forward.
If you’ve saved your payment information with Act Blue Express, your donation will process immediately:
CONTRIBUTE $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=express_lane_10]
CONTRIBUTE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=express_lane_25]
CONTRIBUTE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=50&refcode=express_lane_50]
Friend,
As we’ve been traveling across the district, I keep hearing the same thing:
"This is so important."
Whether it’s a monthly donation of $20, volunteering, or ensuring your friends and neighbors know when to vote, this election is so important.
Our team hears you.
We know your neighbors feel the same way because they’re telling us, too. Our field team returns daily with stories of constituents eager to cast a second ballot for Bob.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/FieldQuote.jpeg]
They know Bob is qualified, he’s serious, he’s deliberate, and as his past coworker told me this weekend,
“He’s exactly the guy you would want running things when things go wrong.”
Whether fighting for a woman’s right to choose, workers’ rights, fighting against corporate greed, reducing gun violence, triaging situations, or speaking out on behalf of good foreign policy, Dr. Bob is the right person to meet the moment for all of us.
We hear you. Rep. Bergman has never faced a second-time challenger, and Dr. Bob is the only viable candidate ready for the fight.
Please donate today and help us take his message to neighbors in the next town.
Have a fantastic week. Dream big.
Best,
Dani

**_Did you know that you can still receive prophetic revelation from God today?

What is prophetic revelation, or "prophecy"?_**
**Prophecy is a word or message given that is divinely inspired by God primarily for the purposes of: **
1. Foretelling the Future
2. Strengthening, Encouraging, and Comforting Us
3. Warning us
4. Rebuking and Correcting Sin in Our Lives
5. Guidance, Instruction, and Exhortation

Did you know that God tells us in Scripture to _eagerly_ desire prophecy?
1 Corinthians 14:1 says, "Follow the way of love and _eagerly desire_ gifts of the Spirit, _especially prophecy_.

The gift of prophecy has been a HUGE blessing in my life! At times a prophetic word has infused me with encouragement, or shown me which direction to go. I've experienced some pretty remarkable, life-changing, prophetic encounters with complete strangers. I'll be sharing some of these amazing experiences with you today on my show.

I hope you'll join us today for the first show in a series we'll be doing about prophecy. If you can't join us live, you may use the same link to watch the recording later.

For God & Country,

as we begin a deep dive into the gift of prophecy. _**

Hello Peter, IT’S ELECTION DAY! The day we have waited for is finally here! I want to tell you how grateful I am for your support throughout this race, Peter. This campaign experience has been crazy, but what I enjoyed most was connecting with you and the community that I love. body:
The stakes of this year's elections couldn't be higher, but I have spent my entire career taking on tough fights in Democratic politics. |
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80325131/459035356/1237601583?refcode=WTEFEO07_20240305_JMAnnouncement_ALL&sourceid=1053051&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZTYzZDBhMy1mOGRhLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hHHJba4m0Q2XHjZe9D5QPGQCi7bfP-qd2SpJ-a8576M=) **Peter, I am honored to share that I've been named the new president of EMILYs List.**

The stakes of this year's elections couldn't be higher, **but I have spent my entire career taking on tough fights in Democratic politics, no matter how hostile the landscape**. I began my work right here at EMILYs List, where I gained a deep understanding of the barriers women — _and particularly women of color_ — face when they step up to run. EMILYs List taught me that to make progressive change, first and foremost, **we have to elect Democratic pro-choice women up and down the ballot, from coast to coast.** **And over the years, I have seen firsthand that through smart work and sheer grit, we _can_ change the face of power.**

Before returning to EMILYs List in 2021, I spent nearly a decade working at all levels of campaigns, all over the country. I packed up my condo just days after my wedding and moved west to run a U.S. Senate campaign in the Las Vegas desert. I went to the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee with a six-week old baby, where I led the most diverse independent expenditure team in the committee's history — a team that deployed a $90 million paid media strategy resulting in more than 40 Democratic House seat pickups.

**To put it plainly, Peter, I've never shied away from a tough fight.** Whenever I'm faced with an opportunity to work towards a better future for our country and our kids, I've always answered, "where do I sign up?"

**There is a fire of outrage in women everywhere** since _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned and Republicans enacted abortion bans all across the country. Women are rising up to say, _we will not be controlled by politicians who know nothing about our bodies and care less about our lives_. **This is the fight EMILYs List is built for, and our work to elect more women everywhere is the answer.** After all, it was another generation of pissed-off women that founded this organization to do just that nearly 40 years ago.

As I take on this new role, I am committed to growing our engagement with younger, more diverse women who will bring underrepresented perspectives to all levels of government. I look forward to serving our pro-choice community with tenacity and integrity.

Thank you for being with me in this fight,

Jessica

There is a fire of outrage in women everywhere since Roe v. Wade was overturned and Republicans enacted abortion bans all across the country. Women are rising up to say, we will not be controlled by politicians who know nothing about our bodies and care less about our lives. This is the fight EMILYs List is built for, and our work to elect more women everywhere is the answer. After all, it was another generation of pissed-off women that founded this organization to do just that nearly 40 years ago. As I take on this new role, I am committed to growing our engagement with younger, more diverse women who will bring underrepresented perspectives to all levels of government. I look forward to serving our pro-choice community with tenacity and integrity. 🚨HISTORICAL turnout at County Conventions!!

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/7c889342d949/n41kepo7ku-12684519?e=25844e23a8)
https://ne.gop/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2d5572d192-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2d5572d192-21732365

** Good Morning Republicans,
------------------------------------------------------------
I am so excited and encouraged to talk about the County Party's this week. As we swing into Convention Season, it's a time of fellowship and engagement. I use the word fellowship purposefully because if we come together in fellowship on our Platform Values, just as we do on our Faith and the Good News, this party will see an exponential growth. Conventions should be fun and an experience for those who attend. It can have the discussions of values, food, and a strong sense of purpose when citizens see the stability within each county. As our County Convention structures outlined, delegates signed up by March 1st to attend their county convention. The County Clerks and Election Commissioners are then coordinating with the County Chair's and myself to affirm the delegates as registered Republicans and residents within the county. From the initial returns of delegate totals, we are going to have an UNPRECEDENTED county convention turnout. 2024 will be a HISTORICAL level of engagement by
Republicans 2-3x greater then before and from these relationships we can move into the next phase of 2024 - Relational Organizing at the door of the voters.
What is relational organizing? At its core, relational organizing is building relationships with the people you KNOW and engaging with them in the political and electoral process. In years past, campaigns have called this a "friends and family program." Repeated studies have shown increased voter turnout and INFLUENCE where relational organizing was used. Which is easier...having conversations about politics, candidates, donation requests, sign location requests, with total STRANGERS or using your ESTABLISHED connections/relationships to discuss values, solutions, and the GOP ENDORSED candidate YOU are supporting?
With new volunteers and relationships we will have the resources to focus on new GROWTH for the Republican party. Do you know that it's been over a decade since the last meaningful Voter Registration drive by the NEGOP? A coordinated, organized, PURPOSEFUL attempt to gain MORE Republican voters through engagement. More voters you say...gosh, what could we do with MORE voters?!? Signing up NEW voters, flipping Independent voters to Republican, flipping Conservative Democrat voters to Republican. The avenues for engagement are limitless, except for the time, talent, energy, and donations (https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=7a94f487f9&e=d0aa4a4733&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2d5572d192-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2d5572d192-21732365) it DOES take to plan events and programs.
I have attached the current voter makeup for Nebraska in a series of images. The key element to understand is how many voting age (18+) citizens are in each county (https://www.census.gov/library/stories/state-by-state/nebraska-population-change-between-census-decade.html?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2d5572d192-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2d5572d192-21732365) . The two lowest populated counties like Arthur & Blaine (https://sos.nebraska.gov/elections/voter-registration-statistics?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2d5572d192-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2d5572d192-21732365) have 95% of the 18+ citizens as voters and a vast majority are Republican. But in Lancaster & Douglas County it's closer to 80% of the 18+ citizens are registered voters. This map shows a total of 18+ citizens in Douglas County, view the chart below to see the number of voters.

https://www.census.gov/library/stories/state-by-state/nebraska-population-change-between-census-decade.html?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2d5572d192-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2d5572d192-21732365
Consider this...if the citizen is over 18 and not a registered voter, then we, as the party, have NEVER knocked on their door to connect them to our VALUES. They don't show up on any list that is readily available as voter data, so we skip them.
What would happen if we sent out teams of people to meet these citizens?
What would happen if we sent out teams of people to discuss the values of the party?
What would happen if we sent out teams of people to LISTEN to their concerns of the direction of our country and state?
...AND...then get them registered to VOTE Republican?
All our 2024 candidates could make an IMMEDIATE impression and connection AND a RELATIONSHIP with this NEW voter by just knocking on their door within the next few weeks after. This methodology for WINNING elections is not NEW, but for the Republican Party in Nebraska...we just have not bothered with it in decades. This is what many, many other states do!

https://sos.nebraska.gov/elections/voter-registration-statistics?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2d5572d192-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2d5572d192-21732365

ADDITIONALLY, look at our Legislative District voter registration makeup and Congressional District makeup. We OUTNUMBER the Democrats in 38 out of 49 Legislative Districts! 5 of the 49 Districts are within a few votes of being in our favor! IF we commit ourselves to growing the Republican Voter base in 2024, we will have a super majority in our Unicameral. This effort should translate outward to all local races such as school boards and County races AND translate upwards to races for Board of Education and Federal. Also, since the ODD numbered Legislative Districts (1, 3, 5, etc.) are always up for election or reelection in a Presidential year, we should take EXTREME advantage of 2024's voter turnout. Every presidential year by in large more voters turnout, so we should always be gaining or retaining elected seats in those years.
https://sos.nebraska.gov/elections/voter-registration-statistics?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2d5572d192-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2d5572d192-21732365

Congressional Breakdown
https://sos.nebraska.gov/elections/voter-registration-statistics?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2d5572d192-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2d5572d192-21732365
So much opportunity in 2024. So much to do!
In addition to the County Conventions, each County will be sending representatives (State Delegates) to the State Convention on May 18th, 2024 in Lincoln. We have an awesome Featured Speaker - Lt. General Michael Flynn! We will be showing his movie "Flynn - Deliver the Truth. Whatever the Cost." on Friday night, May 17th including a Q&A session

FLYNN Movie Premiere Tour
Friday, May 17^th Lincoln, NE
5:00pm Doors open
5:00pm – 6:15pm Meet & Greet
6:30pm Movie starts
8:30pm Q&A session
9:00pm Event ends
https://www.flynnmovie.com/showing/flynn-movie-premier-lincoln-ne/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2d5572d192-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2d5572d192-21732365 (https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=1a46cd6709&e=29f1bbf6e5&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2d5572d192-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2d5572d192-21732365)
https://www.flynnmovie.com/showing/flynn-movie-premier-lincoln-ne/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2d5572d192-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2d5572d192-21732365

If you are interested in experiencing the unique 2024 National Convention where the RNC will nominate the NEXT President of the United States you must be a Nebraska National Delegate.
You might be asking...What is the National Convention (https://gopconvention2024.com/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2d5572d192-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2d5572d192-21732365) ? Go to https://gopconvention2024.com/about/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2d5572d192-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2d5572d192-21732365 (https://gopconvention2024.com/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2d5572d192-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2d5572d192-21732365) for more details.
https://youtu.be/ciqyZRizqdA?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2d5572d192-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2d5572d192-21732365

During what may be the most important election of our lives, it is the job of the RNC’s Committee on Arrangements (COA) to plan a blockbuster, 4-day Convention that will be broadcast across the world. We will host upwards of 50,000 guests in Milwaukee, including the delegates who will nominate the next President and Vice President of the United States.

Thousands of delegates and alternates will be selected by all 56 states and territories. They will travel to Milwaukee, WI July 15-18, 2024, to meet and select the Republican Nominee for President.
Nebraska is allocated 33 National Delegates and 33 Alternates. At our Nebraska State Convention on Saturday, May 18th in Lincoln, we will elect 3 Delegates (and alternates) from each Congressional District (9) AND then 24 At-Large Delegates (and alternates) equaling 33 Delegates and 33 Alternates.
Based on the State Convention Plan submitted to the RNC (Called the 16-F Plan), if you are interested in being a Nebraska Delegate to the National Convention you MUST be a State Delegate or Alternate. To be a State Delegate or Alternate, you MUST be ELECTED at your County Convention, so connect to your county party and let's represent the Cornhusker Nation proudly in Milwaukee on July 18th!
For more details on opportunities to be apart of the National Convention experience email to information@ne.gop (mailto:information@ne.gop?subject=2024%20National%20Convention%20Inquiry) We also have AMAZING Sponsorship opportunities to showcase your business and brands both at our State Convention and National Convention events. These sponsorship's will highlight your company in front of 1000's of Nebraskans and can help gain access to exclusive networking in Milwaukee with key leaders from across the country!
We have plenty of work to do with Legislation Support, support of candidates, connecting to coalition partners, event planning, and discussing the different committee's and groups need to be successful in 2024!
The truth shall set us free.
Blessings,
–Chairman Underwood

subject: It’s Election Day! 🗳️

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=5775%2E5257348%2EfJeQJU ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek,

It’s the day we’ve all been waiting for — today is Election Day!

Our right to vote — a right so many have fought so valiantly for, and
continue to fight for — is so important,
Derek. Our vote determines who
represents us. Our vote determines what laws are passed. Our vote
determines what our country looks like. Not just for us, but for our
children, and our grandchildren. Our vote is sacred.

So it’s worth telling you what I stand for, as I make one final appeal for
your vote.

I stand for you and working families, not the big-money corporations. I
stand for you and fight for universal healthcare, not pharmaceutical
companies. I stand for you and our democracy, not those who wish to
overthrow it.

I stand for you and the future of our planet, not big polluters. I stand
for you and the safety of our kids, not the gun industry. I stand for you
and your rights, not extremists trying to take them away.

I stand for you and for those trying to afford a roof over their heads,
not tax cuts for the wealthy. I stand for you and the most vulnerable, not
the richest amongst us.

Simply put, I stand for you,
Derek. And I always will.

There’s so much work to do. And I can’t wait to get to it from the halls
of the United States Senate. From mitigating rising inflation to
protecting our rights and freedoms. From healthcare to housing. From
climate change to gun safety.

So it’s worth telling you what I stand for, as I make one final appeal for your vote. I stand for you and working families, not the big-money corporations. Hi team,
In honor of today being the 5th of the month, we hope you’ll let us share five reasons why your $5 contribution is so important to GIFFORDS PAC:
1. Today is Super Tuesday, the biggest presidential primary election day of the cycle. We need to be prepared with the resources to ensure we have four more years of President Biden in the White House.

2. Longtime NRA Executive Vice President and CEO Wayne LaPierre announced his resignation from his position in January, and last month he and the NRA were found liable for corruption and financial mismanagement. The NRA is the weakest it’s ever been, and we must do everything we can to defeat them.

3. Gun violence is the NUMBER ONE cause of death for children in America. This is unacceptable. We must do more to keep our children safe from school shootings, domestic violence, accidental shootings, and community violence alike.

4. Our gun safety Senate majority hangs on by a thread. We need to make sure we have the resources to both maintain and expand this slim majority in November.

5. At the end of this month, we’ll be facing our very first FEC fundraising deadline of the election year. We have some big goals to meet so that we can show the strength of our movement for gun safety on our FEC fundraising report.

# [#]It's Election Day in Texas — that means it's time to cast your vote!

The results of today's primary election will be critical to our efforts here at TOP PAC, as we support progressive candidates and combat the far-right political machine. It's going to take each and every single one of us to shut down fascism and win progress.

That's why we want to make sure you have all the information you need before you vote today.

1️⃣ Did you register to vote? Click here [https://www.votetexas.gov/register-to-vote/update-voter-registration.html] to check your registration status.

2️⃣ Find your polling place by clicking here [https://tfn.org/resources/vote-in-texas-elections-hub/] ! All polling locations statewide will be open from 7 AM to 7 PM.

3️⃣ Check out TOP-endorsed candidates. Click here [https://organizetexas.org/about-top-pac/endorsements/] for a list of candidates we’ve endorsed who are committed to a future where ALL Texans can thrive – no matter our age, race, gender, or income.

4️⃣ Cast your vote! Make sure to present a photo ID at your polling place before casting your ballot. Click here [https://www.votetexas.gov/mobile/id-faqs.htm] for more information about the photo requirement.

See you at the polls!

Texas Organizing Project PAC

| Dear Friends and Neighbors,

When I came home from military duty last month, my wife Susan could tell I was distracted. On the same day that U.S. forces were striking Iranian-backed militias in the Middle East, our son, Sergeant Will Dellicker, was arriving in theater to protect American interests in the Horn of Africa.

Susan asked me what was wrong. I told her that I wasn’t ready to be reading the news every day about the latest attacks on U.S. forces and then waiting to hear that Will is safe. She squeezed my hand, looked me in the eye and reassured me.

“Kevin, everything will be ok,” said Susan. “You forget that I’ve already done this four times when you were overseas. We’ll get through this together.”

Right now, thousands of servicemen and women, including hundreds of Pennsylvania Army National Guardsmen, are deployed in harm’s way defending our country. And thousands of family members are left behind praying for their safe return.

In the Guard and Reserves, Members live in their communities, far away from big military bases. There’s no guarantee that other military families live nearby or that support staff are available to help. Often, their neighbors don’t even know they’re deployed.

Susan and I wrote a book about the unique family support challenges affecting the Guard and Reserves. _[Twenty Percent Soldiers](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=966b3472e4&e=1090c5c412)_ provides advice and encouragement to military reservists and their families going through difficult times. Together, Susan and I have shared our story with hundreds of families and donated all book proceeds to benefit veterans and military families.

I want to go to Congress and improve the family support system for all military members, veterans, and first responders. They put their lives on the line to protect us, and their families serve right alongside them. We ask so much of those serving in uniform and their families. They deserve our full support.

If you know someone with a loved-one overseas, please give them a call or pay them a visit. Reassure them, “We’ll get through this together.”

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a Republican from Heidelberg Township, Lehigh County, running for U.S. House of Representatives in Pa.’s 7th District. He is a 28-year military veteran, technology company owner, husband and father. He’s not a career politician. He’s a proven leader with the experience and courage to Keep America Free. Learn more at[www.dellickerforcongress.com](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=9d336a19ca&e=1090c5c412)._

| Hey Peter,

This election, everything is on the line, yet _again_. Reproductive rights, climate change, gun safety, and so much more. We all have a role to play, so make sure you have a plan to VOTE.

This year’s primary election will take place today on Super Tuesday—that's today!

In California, ALL active registered voters receive vote-by-mail ballots (absentee ballots) and can choose to drop off their ballot or vote in person.

| | Dear Friend, Today is the day - Primary Election Day, March 5th, 2024!
I want to extend my heartfelt thanks for your tireless volunteering, unwavering support, and generous contributions. Because of you, our vision for a progressive future and authentic community-based leadership has reached corners far and wide.
Please remember, if you haven't yet voted, today is your final chance to support our movement at the polls. For information on your polling location, visit the [Secretary of State's website here](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/44OuCIo3z/c?w=EYG6-Gpiv-fweijYoX6EjXIi0sPWcRQp-nuU8P068LE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuc29zLmNhLmdvdi9lbGVjdGlvbnMvcG9sbGluZy1wbGFjZSIsInIiOiIzOGVjMTY3ZC1jMDQ2LTQ0OGEtOGIwOS1jZGIzMzdmMzQyOGEiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiI0YWVkNzQ0ZS1kYzNhLTRlMGItYWFmNS02YWZjMTc3NGRmZTMifQ).
For those with a vote-by-mail ballot still in hand, you can drop it off at your polling station or any ballot drop box available in your area. If you're voting in person but have vote-by-mail, remember to bring it with you to turn it in at the polling station. No matter where the results take us tonight, know that your dedication has been the backbone of this campaign. We could not have come this far without you, and we promise to update you soon about where we go from here. But today, let's celebrate our hard work. Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for standing with us. Your support has made all the difference.
---

Peter, Did you know that my opponent Max Miller got married on Trump’s Golf Course in Bedminster, in what was called a “MAGA Wedding?” Max tried to hide this event from the public, but we know former President Trump was in attendance. He even gave a speech praising Max. We know that Trump only loves people who show they’ll follow him unconditionally, no matter what he does. Look how quickly Trump turned on Mike Pence when Pence refused to subvert democracy.
**Between holding his wedding at Trump’s golf course, helping Trump plan the January 6th rally, and singing Trump show-tunes whenever Trump was upset, Max Miller’s shown he’s more Trump sycophant than working class champion.**
Our district doesn’t need Trump devotees. We need leaders who represent all of us. I’m running to deliver solutions for all Ohioans, not just one faction or one leader. Look - the American People are rejecting Joe Biden, not only because he's unfit for office, but for his radical ideology that is destroying America as we know it.

We're seeing a surge of violent crimes at the hands of illegal immigrants...

We're seeing our economy bottom out...

We're seeing the cost-of-living skyrocket out of control...

The power is in your hands right now.

If we all stick together and dig deep right now, we'll send the Biden agenda into the ash heap of history where it belongs.

I'm formally putting Joe Biden on notice. The American People won't forget what he's doing to our country. Please stand with me before I go live.

Senator Katie Britt

Dear Peter,
Like my friend RFK, Jr., I too was a lifelong Democrat. But the party of hardworking American families has largely abandoned them, and is now the party of tech billionaires.
Unfortunately, they are also now the party of censorship, divisiveness, and forever wars.
Neither establishment party has plans to help the American middle class. This middle class has been the backbone and strength of our country. It is what made America the most prosperous nation on earth and the envy of the world.
Through Robert Kennedy, we have a man who will fight for the soul of our Nation. A man of integrity and heart who wishes nothing more than to restore the hope for every American that their hard work will once again allow them and their children to live a better life.
And to ensure that the lifeblood of America, freedom, and individual liberty not only continues, but flourishes!
**But Robert needs our help now more than ever.**
[DONATE NOW](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rob_schneider_3_5_24_rs_nd3&n=5)
After surviving the negative attack ads and character assaults, the mainstream media has gone into its next phase of holding up the rickety establishment facade, ignoring Mr. Kennedy and excluding him from the public debate.
With your help, together we can make the establishment political machine and their paid cronies in the media talk about the issues that Americans actually care about most: the stability of our economy and our country; the health of our children and ourselves; ending taxpayer-funded forever wars; and putting up firewalls between industry and government agencies.
Together we can.
Together we must.
Together we WILL.
Together with Kennedy!

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1195%2E135344%2Ez2Wb7a)

Last month, Donald Trump was here in Michigan.
Our GOP opponents lined up to take a photo with him and urge his support:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar24.YRUw2h&refcode=em240305-1-700&t=2&akid=1195%2E135344%2Ez2Wb7a)
That’s right. Two of our serious Republican opponents proudly stood by Trump as he criticized union workers, attacked voting rights, and bragged about appointing the Supreme Court justices who overturned _Roe v. Wade_ -- and on the heels of news breaking about his private support for a national abortion ban.
What’s more, both of them are former Trump critics who are changing their tune to win a primary. Pensler once said that Trump spoke at a “fourth-grade level.” Rogers spent almost a decade criticizing Donald Trump, even as a paid commentator for CNN. He’s been quoted as saying it’s “time to move on [from Trump],” criticizing Trump’s efforts to overturn the 2020 election, and eviscerating Trump’s national security record. He referred to Trump as a “gangster,” and for the early part of 2023, explored running against Trump in the GOP primary.
This won’t be the last time we see Donald Trump here in Michigan. It also won’t be the last time we see him standing alongside a Republican candidate for the U.S. Senate.
Donald Trump knows that he can’t win the presidency—and Republicans can’t flip the Senate—without winning here in Michigan.
He and his allies are going to do whatever it takes to win here. So we’re asking for $3 to help us stop them.
$3 because the consequences of a Republican Senate and Donald Trump in the White House are too great.
$3 because, unlike our opponents, Elissa doesn’t take a dime of corporate PAC money, so each small-dollar donation adds up in powerful ways for our campaign.
$3 because Democrats’ path to victory runs straight through Michigan, and Elissa cannot keep our state blue without you beside her.

| | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/b1bLYNuSemoR3D4hPn55Wg~~/AARclAA~) Dear Fellow American,

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we are able to communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America. But that's not all. We also delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80346026/459092317/-251759529?refcode=header&source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.03.05_B1_WHM_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ1ODUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2IxMzNjZTQtMGNkYi1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=rnNRMZ5WBKYmRJjql4OfO37gHuqZUS_XLbSsVgRVz08=) | Peter, as we celebrate Women's History Month, I'm reminded of all of the strong women in my life who have helped shape me into the person I am today. My mother taught me from an early age that I could do anything that I set my mind to. Being an optimist, I aimed high and worked hard to make her proud. Her love and guidance instilled in me the grit and determination that I look to in moments of hardship. And my wife, the mother of our four sons, is a rock for the ones she loves and fights hard for what she cares about. She inspires me every day. I'm also thinking of the female trailblazers who led fearlessly in our country. From Shirley Chisholm being the first Black woman to run for president, to South Carolina's own Septima Poinsette Clark who was a driving force behind the Civil Rights Movement. Our country stands on the shoulders of strong women. And Peter, we need to talk about the attacks against women in the past couple of years. _Roe v. Wade_ has since been overturned, and extremist Republicans are hellbent on introducing a national abortion ban. subject: Weekly Update from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12684012?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My fellow Floridians,

We are down to the final days of the 2024 Legislative Session! On Friday, we will complete our time here in Tallahassee. I am so proud of all the hard work my fellow legislators and I put in, but I look forward to being back home in the district with my family. As we head into Week 9, I wanted to update you on where we are in the process and the current status of my legislation.

It has been an incredible honor to serve you in the Florida House. I am excited about the progress we have made to keep the Free State of Florida leading the nation. Thank you for reading!
---
| | **HB 1415 - Peer Support for First Responders**
---
|
---
| I am proud to announce that my legislation to extend peer support to correctional officers and correctional probation officers passed in both the House and Senate. [HB 1415](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=1e13b77ede&e=d1c1b9864f) will support more of our state’s first responders by allowing correctional officers and correctional probation officers to receive physical, moral, or emotional support from a first responder peer to address job-related physical or emotional conditions. It was an honor to carry this important bill during this year’s legislative session. In Florida, we value the well-being of our first responders and want to do our best to support them. I look forward to the positive impact HB 1415 will have on our state. Click on the video below to watch the bill pass on the House Floor.
---
| [ ](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=ede9c55f1e&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
**[Click here to w](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=8ece511ce3&e=d1c1b9864f)[atch HB 1415 pass on the House Floor.](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=7ae181afa1&e=d1c1b9864f)**
| It was a privilege to work alongside several passionate and invested stakeholders to make HB 1415 successful, including [The Thin Silver Line Alliance](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=9c7bc5298e&e=d1c1b9864f), an organization dedicated to advocating for correctional officers and their needs. After the passing of HB 1415, Jeffrey A. Snipes, Executive Director of The Thin Silver Line Alliance, sent me a message that I would also like to share with the district. Read his letter below:

_We accomplished this together as a team. Several organizations involving thousands of correctional and other law enforcement leaders from the deputy level through the command level have been actively involved in this fight for almost 50 years or possibly even longer. We are all fortunate to have been a part of these larger efforts. Praise God for providing us all a way to strengthen and improve ourselves and our profession for the benefit of all whom we encounter and affect in our service and in our daily lives. A great victory has been achieved in the State of Florida, but this is a national effort so we still have a great amount of work ahead of us. This victory truly belongs to us all._

_The Thin Silver Line Alliance extends our heartfelt thanks and gratitude to Representative Ryan Chamberlin of Ocala and all members of the House Civil Justice Subcommittee for sponsoring HB 1415 Peer Support for First Responders.

HB 1415 is truly a landmark piece of legislation with the real potential to save the lives of first responders (Correctional Officers Included)!_
---
| | **Talking About HB 1371 on the Bob Rose Show**
---
| [ ](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=9440afaf34&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
**[Click here to l](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=638e746916&e=d1c1b9864f)[isten to my radio interview on the Bob Rose Show to learn more about HB 1371.](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=cef9216508&e=d1c1b9864f)**
| Property tax is one of the most hated taxes in America. Under this taxation system, no one ever fully owns their property, and we are still constrained by the state government to pay rent to keep our property each year. With [HB 1371](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=d21743e936&e=d1c1b9864f), I hope to start Florida down the road to eliminating this tax. It is time for Florida to take the first step. I had the opportunity to join Bob Rose on his show to share some details about my legislation and what it means for our state. Click on the video above to learn more!
---
| | **My Co-Sponsored Legislation**
---
| During the legislative session, I had the opportunity to support my fellow legislators by co-sponsoring some important legislation for our state. Below are some of the bills I was honored to co-sponsor:

Click on the links to learn more!
* [CS/HB 1 - Online Protections for Minors](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=b959c76f2c&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [CS/CS/HB 3 - Online Access to Materials Harmful to Minors](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=b038a45dae&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [CS/CS/HB 621 - Property Rights](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=853bf40661&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [HB 1223 - Minimum Age for Firearm Purchase or Transfer](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=3564734e8b&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [HB 1227 - Tuskegee Airmen Commemoration Day](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=da6da35326&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [CS/HB 1291 - Educator Preparation Programs](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=aa06b9a623&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [CS/CS/HB 1365 - Unauthorized Public Camping and Public Sleeping](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=42a44b5452&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [HB 1615 - Restrictions on Firearms and Ammunition During Emergencies](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=f1b8c4c8de&e=d1c1b9864f)

There will be more updates to come.
---
|
---
| | It has been an honor to represent District 24 in Tallahassee! The 2024 Legislative Session has been one for the books, and I am incredibly grateful for the opportunity to serve my community. As always, if I may be of any assistance, please do not hesitate to contact my office by **[clicking here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=94518c13dc&e=d1c1b9864f "https://www.myfloridahouse.gov/Sections/Representatives/contactmember.aspx?MemberId=4901&SessionId=103&utm_source=Ryan+Chamberlin+for+State+Representative&utm_campaign=ae0a433299-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_08_05_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7ddd94a0de-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D")**.

Have a great week!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---

State Representative Ryan Chamberlin

1101 The Capitol
402 South Monroe Street
Tallahassee, FL 32399-1300

You can [update your preferences](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/profile?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=929c76fdea&e=d1c1b9864f&c=d30080a3f1) or [unsubscribe from this list](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=929c76fdea&t=b&e=d1c1b9864f&c=d30080a3f1).

subject: Exciting News: Mayor Brainard Endorses Raju Chinthala for Congress!
body:
Dear Friend,

I hope this email finds you well and filled with excitement, as we have some incredible news to share with you today.

We are thrilled to announce that former Carmel **Mayor Jim Brainard** , one of the nation's longest-serving mayors, [has officially endorsed Raju Chinthala in the 5th District Congressional Race! ](https://youtu.be/Q8ZPXTZttQ8)Mayor Brainard's endorsement is a game-changer, a testament to Raju's dedication to our community and his vision for a better future for all. **Video:<https://youtu.be/Q8ZPXTZttQ8>**

This endorsement underscores the momentum our campaign has been building and the growing support from across the district. With Mayor Brainard's backing, we are more confident than ever that we can bring positive change to Central Indiana.

**Voice of the People and Political Endorsements:** <https://www.rajuforcongress.com/endorsements/>

Now, more than ever, we need your support to propel our campaign forward. Here's how you can get involved:

**Contribute: **Your financial support fuels our campaign and allows us to reach more voters across the district. Every dollar counts, no matter the amount. Please consider making a contribution today <https://secure.winred.com/raju-for-congress-inc/donate>

**Volunteer:** Join our grassroots movement by signing up to volunteer. Whether it's making phone calls, knocking on doors, or helping with administrative tasks, your time and energy are invaluable to our success. Sign up to volunteer <https://www.rajuforcongress.com/get-involved/>

**Yard Signs:** Show your support for Raju by displaying a yard sign. Let your neighbors know that you believe in Raju's vision for our community. Request a yard sign today <https://forms.gle/TVndMhfps3uGmF7u5>

**Voices for Raju:** Become a part of Voices for Raju by signing up to endorse his candidacy. Your voice matters, and by publicly endorsing Raju for Congress, you can help us spread the word and build even more support. Sign up to endorse Raju <https://forms.gle/SBK9bwfHuZYRRSbe8>

Together, we can make history and bring real change to the 5th District. With your continued support, we can build a brighter future for all Central Indiana residents. **We are confident in our path to victory on May 7th, 2024.**

Thank you for being a part of this journey with us. We are truly grateful for your unwavering support and dedication. Please do not hesitate to reach me if I can be of any assistance to you.
**RAJU IS FOR YOU!**

Best Regards
Raju Chinthala
Candidate for Congress in Indiana's 5th District
RAJU FOR CONGRESS INC

4000 W. 106th St. Ste.125 # 229 Carmel, IN 46032
M: 317-339-7461 | [rajuchinthala@gmail.com](mailto:rajuchinthala@gmail.com)

name: Geoff Simpson
subject: “AIPAC uncorks $100 million war chest to sink progressive candidates”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Did you see the latest Politico article on AIPAC?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240305.hTxE2u&refcode=em20240305-33647&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=33647%2E1203867%2EFPCseP ]Politico: AIPAC uncorks $100 million war chest to sink progressive
candidates. Building on a successful playbook from 2022, AIPAC and other
aligned groups are picking their targets — many more of them this time.

A handful of Republican billionaire mega-donors are using AIPAC to spend
millions in Democratic primaries against Black and brown progressive
incumbents, and they’re planning to spend an unprecedented $100 million
this cycle. The entire Democratic Party should be united in opposition to
this.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240305.hTxE2u&refcode=em20240305-33647&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=33647%2E1203867%2EFPCseP ]Will you help Justice Democrats stave off AIPAC’s attacks on our
incumbents this spring and summer with a grassroots contribution of
$3 or more today?

Former progressive U.S. Rep. Andy Levin, who lost his seat after AIPAC
spent $4 million against him in 2022, told Politico, “Most candidates
won’t be able to survive that spending barrage...I’m afraid that they can be
quite successful in wiping them out.”

The article further points out, “AIPAC’s biggest targets are members of
the so-called Squad of progressive House Democrats who have been openly
pressuring the administration to call for a cease-fire. But AIPAC’s
ambitions are broader. United Democracy Project, the group’s super PAC, is
monitoring 15 to 20 House races and polling in many of those districts...”

This pro-war, anti-Palestinian, and GOP mega-donor dark money network
threatens not just our progressive movement, but the Democratic Party as a
whole.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240305.hTxE2u&refcode=em20240305-33647&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1003&akid=33647%2E1203867%2EFPCseP ]Right-wing millionaires and billionaires should NOT be shaping and
deciding the outcomes of our Democratic primary elections. Help us fight
back and protect the Squad and the future of the Party by fueling our work
now →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240305.hTxE2u&refcode=em20240305-33647&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1022&akid=33647%2E1203867%2EFPCseP ]Contribute $3

We’ve gone up against AIPAC’s war chest before and won when we elected and
re-elected progressive champions like AOC, Cori Bush, and Jamaal Bowman.
But we need your support now more than ever if we’re going to do it again.

Thanks for all you do,

Geoff Simpson
Campaigns Director

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1023&akid=33647%2E1203867%2EFPCseP ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1024&akid=33647%2E1203867%2EFPCseP ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240305-33647-footer&t=1025&refcode2=33647_1203867_FPCseP&akid=33647%2E1203867%2EFPCseP

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1026&akid=33647%2E1203867%2EFPCseP

PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS. Not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee.
Justice Democrats

Lancaster PA 17603

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/efbd1b8d-2ff6-4290-8c1a-168183b0dc98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In 2009, I saw firsthand how our border and immigration policies work well for corporate elites and showboat politicians, and not any of the rest of us. Back then, while Josh Hawley was working at DC's oldest elite law and lobbying firm, I was training with Border Patrol agents around Yuma, Arizona, ahead of getting deployed to our pointless forever war in Iraq. We all knew then that our border was a mess. The rest of the country knew it too.
Since then, hundreds of politicians like Hawley have centered campaigns on it. Year in and year out, leaders in Congress bicker and negotiate over it. Turn on Fox News, MSNBC, and CNN at any point in the last decade and a half, and you'll see politicians claim they're going to do everything they can to get it done. Campaigns have raised and spent millions of dollars promising to fix it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e77d0cbf-b8bd-4b67-8d6a-84ebcddd1b4e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Fifteen years later, they haven't changed a bit. The border is even more of a mess. And politicians like Josh Hawley have [torpedoed](https://substack.com/redirect/cb16b1e1-d477-4797-b015-102fbbe28838?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) any action to secure our border explicitly for the sake of campaigning.
Hawley is just like the rest of them in Washington. If he fixed the border, then he'd lose one of his favorite campaign props. Hawley (rather famously) would much rather be seen fighting than actually fight to get something done. That'd require putting in real work to get something done, and corporate law didn't prepare him for that. After all, when he worked there, Hawley's old firm (Hogan Lovells, previously Hogan & Hartson) [represented](https://substack.com/redirect/71d22a94-5096-4580-815b-66d602088538?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) anti-union Japanese car companies, Swiss Banks, and dozens more multinational corporations who are profiting just fine off our broken immigration system as it is.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/976d96c4-6c3c-437c-ae0a-b2e52e355795?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
When the bi-partisan deal emerged in the Senate this year, it wasn't perfect. But it provided critical investments and rule changes that would help us further secure the border. That's why the deal was endorsed by the union for Border Patrol officers, the National Border Patrol Council.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5019a815-c4a5-4aa2-ae55-5eeb005fa518?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It took a stab at limiting the record influx of people pooling on our side of the border -- but it didn't address the fact that economic migrants keep erroneously seeking asylum, even as a majority of asylum applications are already being rejected. The deal's expedited work visas represented a hallmark problem of our existing system, with visa availability determined seemingly arbitrarily rather than being set by labor needs or the priorities of American workers. It set a threshold at which asylum entry gets largely restricted automatically when our border is overwhelmed (as it is now), at least somewhat removing our weaker politicians from the equation -- but we needed more of that in the deal. All things that could have been made better, while still providing more of what we needed to secure our border.
But sadly, making this deal better wasn't even possible. Politicians struck once again.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0a603409-e8c9-48ab-bd34-359d87c20741?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Some (like Hawley) opposed this deal before they even knew what was in it, acting like the party of Koch-brother-backed Immigration Reform is suddenly going to fix the border after this next election. But history tells us they're not telling the truth -- when it comes to the border, it hasn't mattered who controls Congress or the White House. Monthly migrant encounters doubled between 2021 and 2022, a huge jump under a Democratic administration. But they also doubled between 2018 and 2019, a huge jump under a Republican administration. And we've seen wave after wave going back decades.
If I learned anything as a Marine in Yuma in 2009 or since then, it's that our politicians are full of it. We can't trust them to fix the border or our broken immigration system. And we sure as hell can't trust a guy like Josh Hawley, who kicked off his career at China's top lobbying firm.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a696f63d-d54e-4ef0-8ab3-342fbc0419a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
That's why, in the U.S. Senate, I'll fight for reform that removes politicians from the equation. If Congress can put bankers, of all people, in charge of monetary policy, they sure as hell can put workers at the head of the table on immigration policy. I'll file legislation that gives working people a leading voice in determining who we need to bring into this country and how we do it, through a democratic body made up of our country's most effective advocates for all workers: Organized labor.
I've said this from day 1 -- I'm running for U.S. Senate to take power back for working people in Missouri. It's time they called the shots on what happens in our country.

clean_body: We need to keep up the pressure in state after state. | | | Friend, More than 101,000 Michigan voters voted “uncommitted” in the Democratic Primary Election last Tuesday. 73 out of 83 Michigan counties voted 10% or more for uncommitted. “This is not an anti-Biden campaign. It is a vote that tells Biden and his administration that we believe in saving lives.” – Layla Elabed, Listen to Michigan Campaign Manager Uncommitted Michigan knows it must push President Biden to change course and end his support for the Israeli government’s genocide of Palestinians. He is not only risking more bloodshed, but putting our democracy and freedoms at risk by abandoning his base of supporters. By failing to represent the 77% of Democrats who support a permanent ceasefire, Biden is risking another Trump term. So voters are flexing their power in presidential primary elections to ensure Biden changes course, saves lives, and becomes more electable before November’s election. The movement to vote uncommitted started in Michigan, and now Listen to Michigan is supporting organizers looking to run similar campaigns in other states across the country. Today in Colorado, Massachusetts, Minnesota, and North Carolina people have the option to vote uncommitted or no preference. Next week, voters will go to the polls in Washington and in Georgia―a state with a large Arab population―to make their voices heard. Activists began Listen to Michigan PAC to use the power of our democracy to make sure our government listens to the people. And they’re rallying the collective strength of our movement to impact Democratic presidential primaries across the country. | Listen to Michigan PAC helped create record “uncommitted” voter turnout in Michigan—and they’re leveraging that momentum to keep the pressure on Biden in primaries across the country. This is how to make sure he finally listens to the base of people who got him elected. Thank you for being a critical part of our movement. This newsletter will keep you up to date on all the things Jen Kiggans is up to around town on the Campaign side of the house. We look forward to sharing stories around the district and keeping you up to date with all the happenings on the campaign trail! This newsletter is for unofficial campaign activities; not official U.S. House of Representatives updates. FEBRUARY’S TOP STORY: Jen hosted the Grand Opening of her Virginia Beach Campaign Office! She is so thankful for the volunteers who helped and to Chairman Richard Hudson and the National Republican Congressional Committee for supporting our new Battle Station. WHAT JEN WAS UP TO IN FEBRUARY… Jen met with local Suffolk pastors and faith leaders at Lake Prince Woods. She is looking forward to working together to build stronger and safer communities! Jen watched STEM in action at the the LEGO Shipbuilding Event sponsored by the Navy League of the United States, Hampton Roads. Jen helped to recognize some amazing people at the Tidewater Friends of Foster Care Gala. As a Mom, she is thankful there are people in the world who open their lives and homes to children. Jen met some local boaters & fishermen at the The Mid Atlantic Sports and Boat Show in Virginia Beach. Jen saw both old and new friends at the Republican Party of Chesapeake meeting. She heard campaign updates from the Republican candidates for many of the local and state wide races. Jen celebrated TWENTY-FIVE years with her husband this month! Jen was joined by campaign volunteers at her first phone banking party! This race will be important to maintaining a conservative majority in the U.S. House Jen celebrated the one year anniversary of the Three Rivers Republican Women's Club. These amazing Republican women hosted a spaghetti dinner at the Ce&H Ruritan Club to celebrate all they’ve accomplished in their first year. Jen welcomed firefighters from across the Commonwealth to Virginia Beach for the Virginia Fire Chiefs Association, Inc. Fire & Rescue Conference. Jen caught up with cadets and staff from the Virginia Military Institute at their General Assembly reception in Richmond. The school’s core values of honor, character, & service are taught to cadets at VMI who then put these values into practice either by serving in the military or leading in their community. Jen attended the Republican Party of Virginia Beach Breakfast. Jen went to the Virginia Fire and Rescue Conference at the Virginia Beach Convention Center. She met first responders from across the Commonwealth & heard about the latest technology and gear they need to protect both themselves and our communities. Jen spent time with some old and new friends at the Isle of Wight Republican Party meeting. She gave an update from Washington and heard the concerns of people from Western Tidewater. Today's the day — it’s primary day in California! Right now, voters are heading to the polls to make their voices heard for our planet's future. **This election cycle, we've taken a stand to support a diverse slate of candidates who reflect California’s fighting spirit.** They’re ready to challenge the status quo and ensure climate policies are rooted in science and promote the health and well-being of our communities, especially those that are being inundated with fossil fuel pollution. Our focus isn't just on the high-profile races. True progress starts from the ground up in down-ballot races where policy decisions directly impact our daily lives. And unlike many organizations, we’re not afraid to jump in early when there’s a strong climate champion running. That’s why we’re championing candidates from the county and state legislative level all the way to the Congressional level. Wherever we feel we can make the most significant impact, that’s where we direct our supporters to get involved and where we choose to allocate our resources. This election is a critical juncture to elect leaders who are really ready to roll up their sleeves and deliver bold climate action. Your support has been incredible, bringing us to this moment where our endorsed candidates in key California primaries could win — but they aren’t quite over the finish line. Our fingers are crossed for all of our candidates in today’s crucial primary, but California is just the start. Over the next 8 months, our endorsed candidates will be on the ballot in Pennsylvania, Oregon and other key states across the country! **[Can we count on your donation today to help propel the Jane Fonda Climate PAC's mission forward? clean_body: Let’s make it count. | Today's the day — it’s primary day in California! Right now, voters are heading to the polls to make their voices heard for our planet's future. This election cycle, we've taken a stand to support a diverse slate of candidates who reflect California’s fighting spirit. They’re ready to challenge the status quo and ensure climate policies are rooted in science and promote the health and well-being of our communities, especially those that are being inundated with fossil fuel pollution. Our focus isn't just on the high-profile races. True progress starts from the ground up in down-ballot races where policy decisions directly impact our daily lives. And unlike many organizations, we’re not afraid to jump in early when there’s a strong climate champion running. That’s why we’re championing candidates from the county and state legislative level all the way to the Congressional level. Wherever we feel we can make the most significant impact, that’s where we direct our supporters to get involved and where we choose to allocate our resources. This election is a critical juncture to elect leaders who are really ready to roll up their sleeves and deliver bold climate action. Your support has been incredible, bringing us to this moment where our endorsed candidates in key California primaries could win — but they aren’t quite over the finish line. Our fingers are crossed for all of our candidates in today’s crucial primary, but California is just the start. body:
Our leaders are totally out of touch with the challenges on the ground.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1043%2E62735%2E1eJUsd)
Peter, I’m fed up:
👉🏾 Michigan ranks **37th in K-12 education**
👉🏾 Michigan ranks **46th in state population growth**
👉🏾 Michigan faces **a housing shortage — worse than the national average —** for both owners and renters
👉🏾 In the last three years, **more small businesses closed their doors for good in Michigan** than in any other state.
Our elected politicians are out of touch with the challenges on the ground, and it’s time for a fundamental change in leadership. **[Chip in $5 today to help me win this race and get to work on these critical challenges.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/705?t=4&akid=1043%2E62735%2E1eJUsd)**
**[DONATE »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/705?t=5&akid=1043%2E62735%2E1eJUsd)**
Look, I’ll be fair: These challenges aren’t the fault of any one politician — it’s the whole damn system that’s broken.
In fact, Michiganders have been sold a bald-faced lie. Election after election, we’ve dedicated time, energy, and resources to electing “leaders” who promised to turn the ship around, only to be let down when push comes to shove in Washington.
**Now more than ever, we need new leaders who understand everyday people's struggles because _they've lived those struggles themselves._**
I've walked in the shoes of everyday Michiganders as a single father.
I’ve fought for workers' rights as a union organizer.
I’ve navigated the challenges of running a small business here in Detroit.
**And that’s EXACTLY why I’m running from the outside, so we can build a better Michigan and _finally_ deliver on our priorities, together.**
**[Please, Peter: Chip in any amount that works for you to help me win this high-stakes Senate race and put Washington back to work for the people.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/706?t=6&akid=1043%2E62735%2E1eJUsd)**

Peter, I’m fed up: 👉🏾 Michigan ranks 37th in K-12 education 👉🏾 Michigan ranks 46th in state population growth 👉🏾 Michigan faces a housing shortage — worse than the national average — for both owners and renters 👉🏾 In the last three years, more small businesses closed their doors for good in Michigan than in any other state. Our elected politicians are out of touch with the challenges on the ground, and it’s time for a fundamental change in leadership. Look, I’ll be fair: These challenges aren’t the fault of any one politician — it’s the whole damn system that’s broken. In fact, Michiganders have been sold a bald-faced lie. Election after election, we’ve dedicated time, energy, and resources to electing “leaders” who promised to turn the ship around, only to be let down when push comes to shove in Washington. Now more than ever, we need new leaders who understand everyday people's struggles because they've lived those struggles themselves. I've walked in the shoes of everyday Michiganders as a single father. I’ve fought for workers' rights as a union organizer. I’ve navigated the challenges of running a small business here in Detroit. | | _**_Meet Tom Cotton_**_

Tom Cotton was born and raised on his family's cattle farm in Arkansas, served as an Army infantry officer in Iraq and Afghanistan, and is fighting for working Americans in the U.S. Senate.

The tragic attacks of September 11, 2001 occurred during Tom's final year of law school and changed his life's trajectory.

After clerking on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit and spending a short time in private law practice, he joined the United States Army as an Infantry Officer, spending nearly five years on active duty.

Between his two combat tours he served as a platoon leader with the Old Guard at Arlington National Cemetery, the unit responsible for military honors funerals.

Tom's military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal, Combat Infantry Badge, and Ranger Tab.

In the U.S. Senate, he's fighting the tough battles for Arkansans and Americans, and delivering real results. He knows that only the strong can survive in a dangerous world, and he's building a movement to make America strong again.

Team,

We wanted to take this opportunity to thank you for investing in us and helping us reach our February End of Month fundraising goal.

This has been a big week, where Republicans have dropped the ball on everything from reproductive rights to immigration to general governance responsibilities — and we’re so proud that we were able to mobilize as a party to hit our goal and get prepared for this upcoming November.

We also wanted to notify you that this month is an End of Quarter month, meaning we have some pretty ambitious goals to hit since we’ll be closing the book on the whole quarter. We want to be honest: we’ll be asking for money quite a bit this month, but you know how important it is that we do what we do.

Like it or not, Trump is on the ballot in November. If we don’t buckle down, his MAGA-extremist supporters could win races down the ballot across the state.

We can combat that, we just have to be prepared.

Thank you for everything you’ve done so far, we’re honored.

Thanks,
IDCCA

name: Rick Coplen
subject: It’s Women’s History Month
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Rick Coplen
body:
|
---
March is Women’s History Month, a time to celebrate the countless women who have shaped our country and world and recognize the work still ahead to achieve true gender equality.

Suffragettes fought fiercely to grant half the population a voice in our democracy that had previously been denied, and their work forever changed the face of the American electorate.

Yet today, women still have to fight for principles as fundamental as bodily autonomy and equal pay.

As the husband to a strong woman and the father of two extraordinary young women, I have always believed and strongly advocated for equal rights for all. When I’m in Congress, I will fight to defend the rights and liberties of all women – whether it’s reproductive freedoms, pay equity, or the elimination of sexism wherever it exists.

[If you’re with me, sign on here to double down on our shared fight for equality!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80361012/459123898/-1936499266?source=RC_EM_PT_WL_240305_1_1&refcode2=843e0b91-1bdb-ee11-85f9-002248223197&contactdata=Gut9ecERAD44qWuhAGfGsRFzvQGJZVEp5TqRP+BgWhhYAFShrYBGaP3ilXTU2l0O&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NDNlMGI5MS0xYmRiLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4A7uHeMEIHYJWouU_1bhIZCyfyvuhI7FXZDTvxfPaS0=&emci=16c83aff-16db-ee11-85f9-002248223197&emdi=843e0b91-1bdb-ee11-85f9-002248223197&ceid=24669367) | | **[FIGHT FOR EQUALITY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80361013/459123899/-1936499266?source=RC_EM_PT_WL_240305_1_1&refcode2=843e0b91-1bdb-ee11-85f9-002248223197&contactdata=Gut9ecERAD44qWuhAGfGsRFzvQGJZVEp5TqRP+BgWhhYAFShrYBGaP3ilXTU2l0O&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NDNlMGI5MS0xYmRiLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4A7uHeMEIHYJWouU_1bhIZCyfyvuhI7FXZDTvxfPaS0=&emci=16c83aff-16db-ee11-85f9-002248223197&emdi=843e0b91-1bdb-ee11-85f9-002248223197&ceid=24669367)**

Today, women’s bodily autonomy is under unprecedented attack. Anti-choice extremists succeeded in dismantling abortion rights, and now they’re taking aim at other critical reproductive care like IVF.

Simply put, we cannot have true equality in our democracy while millions of women are denied basic rights. Unlike Scott Perry, in Congress, I will vote for both laws and a constitutional amendment to ensure that the reproductive freedom of women is once again guaranteed in America.

Much more work must be done to deliver on our country’s promise of securing equal rights for all. I’m ready for the fights ahead – are you with me?

[Add your name in celebration of Women’s History Month and recommit to uplifting women’s rights today and every day!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80361014/459123900/-1936499266?source=RC_EM_PT_WL_240305_1_1&refcode2=843e0b91-1bdb-ee11-85f9-002248223197&contactdata=Gut9ecERAD44qWuhAGfGsRFzvQGJZVEp5TqRP+BgWhhYAFShrYBGaP3ilXTU2l0O&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NDNlMGI5MS0xYmRiLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4A7uHeMEIHYJWouU_1bhIZCyfyvuhI7FXZDTvxfPaS0=&emci=16c83aff-16db-ee11-85f9-002248223197&emdi=843e0b91-1bdb-ee11-85f9-002248223197&ceid=24669367) | **[FIGHT FOR EQUALITY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80361015/459123901/-1936499266?source=RC_EM_PT_WL_240305_1_1&refcode2=843e0b91-1bdb-ee11-85f9-002248223197&contactdata=Gut9ecERAD44qWuhAGfGsRFzvQGJZVEp5TqRP+BgWhhYAFShrYBGaP3ilXTU2l0O&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NDNlMGI5MS0xYmRiLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4A7uHeMEIHYJWouU_1bhIZCyfyvuhI7FXZDTvxfPaS0=&emci=16c83aff-16db-ee11-85f9-002248223197&emdi=843e0b91-1bdb-ee11-85f9-002248223197&ceid=24669367)**

clean_body: | March is Women’s History Month, a time to celebrate the countless women who have shaped our country and world and recognize the work still ahead to achieve true gender equality. Suffragettes fought fiercely to grant half the population a voice in our democracy that had previously been denied, and their work forever changed the face of the American electorate. Yet today, women still have to fight for principles as fundamental as bodily autonomy and equal pay. As the husband to a strong woman and the father of two extraordinary young women, I have always believed and strongly advocated for equal rights for all. When I’m in Congress, I will fight to defend the rights and liberties of all women – whether it’s reproductive freedoms, pay equity, or the elimination of sexism wherever it exists. | | Today, women’s bodily autonomy is under unprecedented attack. Anti-choice extremists succeeded in dismantling abortion rights, and now they’re taking aim at other critical reproductive care like IVF. Simply put, we cannot have true equality in our democracy while millions of women are denied basic rights. Unlike Scott Perry, in Congress, I will vote for both laws and a constitutional amendment to ensure that the reproductive freedom of women is once again guaranteed in America. Much more work must be done to deliver on our country’s promise of securing equal rights for all. I’m ready for the fights ahead – are you with me? | Thanks for stepping up. – Rick | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Friends of Rick Coplen | =

It’s only with the help of IVF treatments that my wife Mary El and I were able to have our much-wanted, much-loved, youngest son. We are incredibly grateful to the staff at the Assisted Reproductive Technology Institute at Walter Reed for helping bring Philip into our lives. The journey with infertility can be a long and painful one. _For many families, IVF is one of the last options for having a baby._ But now, this vital medical service is at risk. A court case in Alabama resulted in IVF treatment centers shutting down in that state and **Republicans in the Senate are blocking legislation that would protect IVF services across the nation.** It is infuriating, Peter, that Republicans continue to chip away at our freedoms, including the freedom to have a child. _This is yet another example of why there’s no space for clueless politicians to be in the doctor’s examination room._ As a physician myself, I strongly believe that reproductive health care decisions should be between a patient and a doctor. In Congress, I will support legislation to codify IVF federal protections and protect *ALL* reproductive freedoms. **Reproductive healthcare is bound to be a tough battle. But I’m a 25-year U.S. Army veteran,_I know tough battles_.** And you better believe, if I'm elected to the U.S. Congress, I will fight every single day to protect reproductive health care and rights. [**If you’re in this fight with me, please pitch in a donation of $20.24 to mobilize and organize every corner of my critical swing district (the only tossup district in Maryland).**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf8ddf8b6-9ade-41dd-b8fc-54795ce70fbf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. Are you ready?

| |
