Friend,

Over the last year, we've pounded the pavement, shared my message, shook every hand, answered every question, and left no stone left unturned.

**NOW, a day we 've all worked so hard for is here - Super Tuesday!**

_Are you ready?_

Polls are open in states across the country, and we're fighting for every vote.

Today, voters will have a choice to elect a new generational leader and move on from the drama and chaos of the past.

They will have a choice to elect a leader who can **DEFEAT** Joe Biden in November and right the ship to save our country.

**[Will you chip in and join me in this fight today?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HrkULzGRWdFT6HLsHzGqJQ~~/AARclAA~ "Will you chip in and join me in this fight today?")**

---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HrkULzGRWdFT6HLsHzGqJQ~~/AARclAA~)
---

Since day one of this campaign, I've listened to the American people--not the political class.

_And I can tell you_ , Americans across the country believe we can do so much better--that we must do better.

And they know when our country's future is on the line, you fight harder than ever.

That's why my team and I will be out in full force today making a crucial push to reach voters, make phone calls, knock doors, and get the vote out before the polls close tonight... but we cannot do it alone.

_We need**YOU** to join us during this critical stretch. _

**[Can I count on support from you right now?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HrkULzGRWdFT6HLsHzGqJQ~~/AARclAA~ "Can I count on support from you right now?")**

---
| | [DONATE](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HrkULzGRWdFT6HLsHzGqJQ~~/AARclAA~)
---

We are fighting for every inch because we have a country to save.

We can live in a world where we strongly disagree without hating each other.

We can live in a world where our kids aren't worried about how they'll get a job or if they'll ever be able to own a home.

We can live in a world where we restore normalcy and move on from the chaos of the past.

I'm willing to take the cuts, the bruises, and the name calling.

But I need you on my side every step of the way.

**[Will you chip in $10 or more TODAY?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HrkULzGRWdFT6HLsHzGqJQ~~/AARclAA~ "Will you chip in $10 or more TODAY?")**

Please join us now...before it is too late.

You can help determine the outcome of this race and our country's future.

Thank you in advance.

**Let 's do this!**
---

My very best,
---

Nikki Haley

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**Peter, I am honored to share that I've been named the new president of EMILYs List.**

The stakes of this year's elections couldn't be higher, **but I have spent my entire career taking on tough fights in Democratic politics, no matter how hostile the landscape**. I began my work right here at EMILYs List, where I gained a deep understanding of the barriers women — _and particularly women of color_ — face when they step up to run. EMILYs List taught me that to make progressive change, first and foremost, **we have to elect Democratic pro-choice women up and down the ballot, from coast to coast.** **And over the years, I have seen firsthand that through smart work and sheer grit, we _can_ change the face of power.**

Before returning to EMILYs List in 2021, I spent nearly a decade working at all levels of campaigns, all over the country. I packed up my condo just days after my wedding and moved west to run a U.S. Senate campaign in the Las Vegas desert. I went to the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee with a six-week old baby, where I led the most diverse independent expenditure team in the committee's history — a team that deployed a $90 million paid media strategy resulting in more than 40 Democratic House seat pickups.

**To put it plainly, Peter, I've never shied away from a tough fight.** Whenever I'm faced with an opportunity to work towards a better future for our country and our kids, I've always answered, "where do I sign up?"

**There is a fire of outrage in women everywhere** since _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned and Republicans enacted abortion bans all across the country. Women are rising up to say, _we will not be controlled by politicians who know nothing about our bodies and care less about our lives_. **This is the fight EMILYs List is built for, and our work to elect more women everywhere is the answer.** After all, it was another generation of pissed-off women that founded this organization to do just that nearly 40 years ago.

As I take on this new role, I am committed to growing our engagement with younger, more diverse women who will bring underrepresented perspectives to all levels of government. I look forward to serving our pro-choice community with tenacity and integrity.

Thank you for being with me in this fight,

Jessica

Jessica Mackler (she/her/hers)
President, EMILYs List

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

clean_body: Are you ready? | | | | | | | Friend, Over the last year, we've pounded the pavement, shared my message, shook every hand, answered every question, and left no stone left unturned. NOW, a day we 've all worked so hard for is here - Super Tuesday! Are you ready? Polls are open in states across the country, and we're fighting for every vote. Today, voters will have a choice to elect a new generational leader and move on from the drama and chaos of the past. They will have a choice to elect a leader who can DEFEAT Joe Biden in November and right the ship to save our country. "Will you chip in and join me in this fight today?" | Since day one of this campaign, I've listened to the American people--not the political class. And I can tell you , Americans across the country believe we can do so much better--that we must do better. And they know when our country's future is on the line, you fight harder than ever. That's why my team and I will be out in full force today making a crucial push to reach voters, make phone calls, knock doors, and get the vote out before the polls close tonight... but we cannot do it alone. We needYOU to join us during this critical stretch. "Can I count on support from you right now?" | | We are fighting for every inch because we have a country to save. We can live in a world where we strongly disagree without hating each other. We can live in a world where our kids aren't worried about how they'll get a job or if they'll ever be able to own a home. We can live in a world where we restore normalcy and move on from the chaos of the past. I'm willing to take the cuts, the bruises, and the name calling. But I need you on my side every step of the way. "Will you chip in $10 or more TODAY?" Please join us now...before it is too late. You can help determine the outcome of this race and our country's future. Thank you in advance. Let 's do this! My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. Dear Friend,

Your participation in Hillsdale College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?

https://click.buildourmovement.com/?qs=de72aca162586b1cd4e690e14b1a39cfbb0f4ee95020a1334ab10f03dd58d874879d5f8e5185bb8e70d95b069dc6a12068df57a2434f71e8

NO

Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a Boston Globe op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

That is why I'm reaching out to you today...

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

Together, we’re building a multi-racial, multi-generational, multi-party coalition like nothing Tennessee has seen before. I know that sharing my message with voters face-to-face is the best way to grow this movement. It’s why we’ve planned to put a lot of time, effort, and resources into traveling across the state and hosting campaign events. But I’m well aware that I can’t talk to all 7 million Tennesseans personally! We’ll also need to devote resources to canvassing efforts, running ads on TV and online, and other methods of getting our message out. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thanks! Gloria = | Gloria Johnson is running for the U.S. Senate because Tennesseans deserve leaders who care. For too long, elected officials like Marsha Blackburn have done absolutely nothing to make Tennesseans’ lives better. The only interests they’ve cared about are special interests. The only people they’ve championed are their donors. Gloria will advocate for real solutions to protect our communities from gun violence, make health care more affordable and accessible for all of us, secure access to the ballot box, and defend reproductive rights. | = = Follow along: | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Gloria for Tennessee Contributions or gifts to Gloria for Tennessee are not tax deductible. | | Our 2024 goals are clear:
* Flip the House
* Defend the Senate Democratic Majority
* Hold the White House

**It's time to organize to win. We'll have to take on right-wing dark money and disinformation, but our grassroots team is strong, and I know we can get it done because we've done it before.** Republicans have shown time and time again that they're not interested in or capable of governing. body:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80376234/459149551/-575414752?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY3NTUyNTM1LTI5ZGItZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzE5NyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=D0443RVKDNvWPfUfkdDcVx_yAM0tRYR7kdy81ULDLho=&emci=91b07255-1edb-ee11-85f9-002248223197&emdi=f7552535-29db-ee11-85f9-002248223197&ceid=2107230) | | | Hi Peter, The clock is ticking for the protection of the Owyhee Canyonlands; a one-of-a-kind, magical, and ancient place. **[Senators Ron Wyden and Jeff Merkely have laid the groundwork for the permanent protection of the Owyhee Canyonlands, and we now need President Biden to finish their work before the end of this year.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80376235/459149554/-1153890425?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY3NTUyNTM1LTI5ZGItZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzE5NyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=D0443RVKDNvWPfUfkdDcVx_yAM0tRYR7kdy81ULDLho=&emci=91b07255-1edb-ee11-85f9-002248223197&emdi=f7552535-29db-ee11-85f9-002248223197&ceid=2107230)** The Owyhee Canyonlands are one of Oregon’s most critical and vulnerable areas. Its protection or designation as a National Monument would safeguard significant historical, cultural, and recreational resources, and ensure responsible and balanced recreation. This would also further grow the region’s economy. It is the largest conservation opportunity in the American West. We need to permanently protect the Owyhee from industrial development, climate change, unmanaged recreation, and more that are becoming increasingly aggressive threats to the area, as Oregon has one of the fastest growing rates in the West. The Owyhee Canyonlands cannot wait any longer - after a three-decade-long effort to protect it - and with 80% of Oregonians in favor of designating this magical place a National Monument. Oregon’s wildlands are quickly disappearing, and by protecting the Owyhee now, we keep its natural wonder intact before it suffers irreparable damage. It’s crucial that we show President Biden and Senators Ron Wyden and Jeff Merkely how important it is to us that the Owyhee Canyonlands become a National Monument before it is too late. **[Help us send them a message now by signing this petition!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80376236/459149562/-1153890425?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY3NTUyNTM1LTI5ZGItZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzE5NyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=D0443RVKDNvWPfUfkdDcVx_yAM0tRYR7kdy81ULDLho=&emci=91b07255-1edb-ee11-85f9-002248223197&emdi=f7552535-29db-ee11-85f9-002248223197&ceid=2107230)** Thank you for advocating for the Owyhee Canyonlands!
Sincerely, Britney VanCitters
Political & Organizing Director, OLCV | |

Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=46bc2defe3ba45a583ce69e2d9feec34&_e=yw4pDrjoMyM9p0b4ymns2ceBcmcLzbkRkxFrEca8ld3ReS6Dy9cPzWkuVLHSXHchJVNGo5Vclo9FYvs9bK5hhZZKDb1bIoyTHWc7M3tnFzRFL2z_LgL1n0TVYTICr8J8iPeWuEBGQsm5JaOnPaUFJpG3zdvF8xiR2O7Lv0G3ydDmqewdB7x0gU6hj34wAQI2LU_gPbnE4vBpScyqJqLGvhFtjznJt6Ou_68neJ3xNXzvFPh5q7jA1KVZynBDrYQVmGuviF84Q_P0Nh-wUgPkbUaO6O8s9NsRTiOJAH0guLHk3r8CzZENjTdWrlaYhV02iS1xkHUsiTZjgT8MWN0wIh_INNOf1IAPVYSkekvoZbeW5nSI0pVC99-hZSdmmOjWz2m7dv7RlZr7vyKTpeOmQg%3D%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Fellow American, You have an opportunity to help correct one of the worst injustices of the Covid era. **Thou****sands of hardworking, competent people were fired –– all because they refused to get the Covid shot.** Doctors, nurses, teachers, members of the military, and many more. It’s the natural tendency of the authoritarian left to punish people for refusing to go along with its schemes. And now that we know more of the truth about Covid, the vaccine, and the shady collusion between government organizations, Big Tech and Big Pharma......they’d love nothing more than to sweep this all under the rug and pretend it never happened. **That’s why I’ve instructed our attorneys at the Center for American Liberty to initiate legal action to hold them accountable.** For starters, we filed a lawsuit against the North Carolina Symphony on behalf of three musicians fired for refusing to get the COVID vaccine._Each of them had been in the Symphony for over a decade._ **[**And if we can win this critical legal battle, we can put employers across the country on notice that they should reinstate victims of their COVID vaccine firings.**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b163a5ffd9644dca85ff26648a0369a0&_e=EBiJjBzZ1WDHLEewCPU1QqETHUlxbdHSGs05f411m_k1IfgTktKl0X06WXgCHqUw_AY4zin6jw9oQ1hLPvBQGExIcbVdEDThVMv53lMxmLPU2mj_vWCydJjvw2-YqLhxS-qlXy-7_72NMZ45Fzx39O-q2Z19iQPJDj9-ZuYIkWhrvOfjJ0ovpY4Viy2YBa8KUh9OptAhoDmh8Ns1wIV7xxQLDBaD6J9xKKsx3siADfRVNVmj-Kiss-4QmdujeatCph6FG3lV-gKNU8VWzH5qz5RqTq7YssydsQ4Z0QefX0IfEcmXIV7SyHXkIiHg8jSk9G1E5WQxhUqcmBoNmrcRyeE3gu0hRJKGCCwXMi9-EJ3a-b9_Cxun1ebeW5rAHG1d)** When the Symphony introduced their vaccine mandate, it offered both religious and medical exemptions.Dovid, Chris, and Rachel each held sincere religious beliefs, filed for exemptions, and expressed a willingness to take other measures—like regular COVID testing—to ensure safety.But the Symphony rejected ALL of them and put them on a year of UNPAID LEAVE.These three musicians were Buddhist, Christian and Jewish. **To you and me, the freedom to practice your religion is a sacred right.****So is your right to bodily autonomy.** But in the eyes of the cultural Marxists who control so many institutions in America today, your body doesn’t belong to you – it belongs to them. They’ll decide where you go... They’ll decide what you need... They’ll decide what you can have... They’ll decide what vaccines you must take...In other words: _Your individual liberties_ will cease to exist.The good news is that while cultural Marxism is popular on college campuses, legacy media press rooms, the boardrooms of woke companies and inside government bureaucracies......the vast majority of Americans are against it. This is a fight we can win – and we must win. **[**You can join me today by making a generous, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty to fund this lawsuit for medical and religious freedom, and set a precedent nationwide that puts these radicals on notice.**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b163a5ffd9644dca85ff26648a0369a0&_e=EBiJjBzZ1WDHLEewCPU1QqETHUlxbdHSGs05f411m_k1IfgTktKl0X06WXgCHqUw_AY4zin6jw9oQ1hLPvBQGExIcbVdEDThVMv53lMxmLPU2mj_vWCydJjvw2-YqLhxS-qlXy-7_72NMZ45Fzx39O-q2Z19iQPJDj9-ZuYIkWhrvOfjJ0ovpY4Viy2YBa8KUh9OptAhoDmh8Ns1wIV7xxaGvTluAldiiORr3x-IwkYX7vw1nVeYzO-I2_LCHiMq5YL7lt21ERYYneKK-2tnSN1vKLXq7_kcz9cFrM8E6cG5Ru8ptEUOdi4MWZaPHd-6djsSbphlHPcyFR1-y70YXzA-5Gw4U2ujcLvd8SWcuMRXXaKtV40y4WqA45rg1q_H)** Even after the North Carolina Symphony lifted its vaccine mandate, it refused to give these musicians their jobs back.Because it was never about “science” or “health” – it was always about control.And it’s time to tell the cultural Marxists who want to control every aspect of your life that we aren’t backing down.I hope I can count on your support.

| Peter,

As we welcome the month of March, we also embrace the powerful legacy of Women's History Month. It's a time to honor the extraordinary contributions of women throughout history, reflect on our progress, and, most importantly, look toward the future we are creating together.

As an incumbent in Congress, I have had the immense privilege of working alongside remarkable women from all walks of life. Their stories, their struggles, and their triumphs have fueled my passion for public service.

We have made significant strides, but our work is far from over. **We continue to fight for equal pay, affordable healthcare, reproductive rights, and so much more. Every day, I am reminded of the importance of our voices in the halls of power.**

This Women's History Month, I invite you to join me in celebrating the strength, resilience, and achievements of women everywhere. Your support is crucial as we strive to build a future where every woman and girl can reach her full potential.

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: The team that will win in Arizona
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
#
Derek, when I was first thinking about launching this campaign last year I had no idea what to expect.
I knew I had some supporters from my congressional campaigns that I could count on, but beyond that it was a shot in the dark.
One thing I knew for sure was that whether this was a 2-way race, a 3-way race, a 27-way race, whatever -- I was going to need the support of a huge grassroots team behind me. Over the last year we’ve built that team, with close to 150,000 individual donors.
**And now we know: Sinema’s out. This race is a head-to-head between me and Kari Lake. And we've got to expand out that grassroots team and build a coalition here in Arizona that can defeat her.**
I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. So today, I’m asking you, very humbly, to make a donation to my campaign.
**[Please, split a $5 or $10 donation between John Fetterman and my campaign. Whatever you can afford can help us build the team that’s going to win in Arizona. Your support is critical to defeating Kari Lake and holding our Senate majority.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240305-1?refcode=em20240305-1-8819&refcode2=8819_434096_N7szJr&akid=8819%2E434096%2EN7szJr)**

Thanks a lot for this. I really appreciate it.
Ruben

demanding that President Biden call for a permanent Ceasefire?

Today is Super Tuesday, and our movement has a strategic opportunity to
send a message for Peace at the ballot boxes all across the country.

* In California, Our Revolution is backing Barbara Lee for the U.S.
Senate — the only candidate in the race calling for an immediate
ceasefire in Gaza — along with 100 pro-peace progressives down-ballot.
* In other Super Tuesday states — including Colorado, Massachusetts,
Minnesota and others — we’re encouraging our members to signal their
demand for Peace by voting uncommitted or no preference.
* And, in Washington state next Tuesday, we’re mobilizing our 132,000
supporters to make the primary a megaphone for Peace and reinforce our
demand for a ceasefire.

still hasn’t changed his policies, we must appeal to his fundamental,

An occasional update from Dr. Vikram Mansharamani ... | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mansharamani/the-making-of-a-generalist?e=93b2c2b824)
---
# The Making of a Generalist
_An Independent Thinker Finds Unconventional Success in an Uncertain World_
| [CLICK HERE TO BUY YOUR COPY](https://mansharamani.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=caf139d4582deef486da11685&id=958ab9652c&e=93b2c2b824)
---
|
---
Dear Friends,
It’s been a little over six weeks since my new book was released and it’s been really well-received. It’s been ranked #1 in various categories on Amazon multiple times and I’ve had lots of invitations from large groups to discuss the book’s main messages. I’m writing to seek your assistance. While I would of course appreciate it if you could buy (another) copy, I’m really love your help with the following:

1. Recommend _**The Making of a Generalist**_ as a topic for a virtual or in-person book event at any professional association, social club, or teacher/parent group that you think might enjoy a conversation with me about the book’s main ideas. I’m actively seeking to diversify the groups that are aware of the book and would welcome your help!

2. Rate and review _**The Making of a Generalist**_ on Amazon. This is something that is apparently more important than I realized as it affects Amazon’s recommendation algorithms and their willingness to suggest my book to likely buyers. Time is of the essence so I’d welcome

3. Post a picture of you holding the book on social media. If you mention me (@mansharamani on twitter), I’ll be able to repost or share your post with my network. All of my social links are available at [**linktr.ee/mansharamani**](https://mansharamani.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=caf139d4582deef486da11685&id=01aced800e&e=93b2c2b824).

Please reach out to me directly at [vikram@mansharamani.com](mailto:vikram@mansharamani.com) or via my cell 603-290-9595 if you have any questions. Thank you in advance for your help!
Best,
PS. For those that are interested in receiving access to my weekly posts, please visit [mansharamani.substack.com](https://mansharamani.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=caf139d4582deef486da11685&id=fcf6503340&e=93b2c2b824) to subscribe (for free) to _**Navigating Uncertainty**_ , my newsletter about generalist thinking in a specialized world.
|
---
#### _The Making of a Generalist: The Backstory_

After my unsuccessful campaign for the US Senate in 2022, I spent time reflecting on my life experiences and lessons learned. Writing (when not skiing or hiking at Loon Mountain) became my “therapy” and helped me better understand my first 50 years on this planet. The book is a deeply personal reflection on failures, challenges, and successes along the path to who I am today.
The book also takes lessons acquired from my entry into politics and puts them into the context of my prior work. My first book, [Boombustology](https://mansharamani.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=caf139d4582deef486da11685&id=0abee38113&e=93b2c2b824), suggested the use of multiple lenses offered a path to unique insights when it came to spotting financial bubbles. My next book, [Think for Yourself](https://mansharamani.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=caf139d4582deef486da11685&id=1c8c8c21be&e=93b2c2b824), suggested every perspective was limited, biased, and incomplete and the best way to navigate uncertainty was to triangulate multiple views. When I entered the world of politics, however, I found most people were quick to label folks on a single dimension of Right to Left. The Making of a Generalist suggests we could all be better off by adding dimensions to our political discourse: what about open-minded versus closed-minded? or process-oriented versus outcome-oriented? I’m calling for more civil civic engagement.

clean_body: | = Aloha Peter, Today is March 5, 2024 — so we’re exactly 8 months away from Election Day. = | | = Ever since Donald Trump’s ascendancy, our elections have become even more consequential as Republicans line up behind him and his extremist agenda. If you’re already stressed about this November, I get it. So here's a little perspective, Peter: In 2022, pundits and elections analysts were stunned when Democrats not only defended, but expanded our Senate majority as voters across the country defiantly turned out in support of reproductive freedom. But me? I wasn’t surprised one bit. I wasn’t surprised because I saw the power of this grassroots team firsthand. Countless folks chipped in what they could and helped us mobilize voters in battleground states across the country — month after month, week after week, day after day — and the results spoke for themselves. I know that securing our razor-thin Senate majority, winning back the House, and re-electing President Biden is all possible. I agree with the 9-0 Supreme Court decision allowing former President Trump to appear on the ballot in 2024.
The Court rightly decided that it is wrong for individual states to attempt to remove Trump over and above the will of the people.
_In a democracy,_ _it is the voters who are supposed to decide who takes office_.
In authoritarian countries, voters only get to choose from a roster of government-approved candidates. We must not let America move further in that direction.

_To do that, we have to get onto the ballot in every state._
The two parties’ candidates are on the ballot automatically. Not me. We have to muster a 50-state ground game to be listed.
**_And we will face the same sort of legal shenanigans that Trump faces in an effort to remove our campaign from the ballot._**

# 2024 March e-newsletter
News and information for District 5 in San Mateo County.
---
|
---
|
---
| **County offers new lifeline for those in mental health crisis**
---
| Dear friends, The Board of Supervisors unanimously voted Tuesday, February 27 to adopt a resolution authorizing a $4.9 million two-year agreement with Telecare Corporation for “Unarmed Mobile Mental Health Crisis Response Services” for individuals in crisis and their families who call 988 or the StarVista hotline at (650) 579-0350. We’ve seen suicide rates continue to climb which is a leading cause of death for children aged 10-14, young adults 20-34, and men, mostly white, 75 years and older. Now, the county will be able to provide unprecedented services, offering a new lifeline with in-person clinical support for those in crisis or feeling suicidal right where you live. This is 24/7 unarmed and compassionate approach meant to keep individuals out of our emergency rooms or jails and handled with care by trained clinicians.
---
The service will partially begin in May with one team during evening weekday hours before fully ramping up by August to five 24/7 teams and two on-call teams. It will be for people who do not need immediate hospitalization. Once 988 calls are screened by StarVista, the hotline will dispatch clinicians trained in crisis assessment, de-escalation and intervention. They will arrive in nondescript vehicles – no lights and sirens – around-the-clock, any day of the year with the goal of stabilizing situations and, if necessary, taking individuals or arranging transportation to the appropriate level of care. The County along with Telecare and StarVista will develop an outreach campaign to promote awareness of the hotline number and the service.
---
| **Hasty CPUC decision on Waymo is shocking** On Friday, March 1 the CPUC’s Consumer Protection and Enforcement Division (CPED) announced it will allow Waymo to operate in San Mateo and Los Angeles counties after it suspended its permit for up to 120 days Feb. 1 because of objections both counties made due to a lack of meaningful engagement to address public safety concerns. I thought the CPUC gave us 120 days to sit down with Waymo and discuss our concerns here in San Mateo County. I’m confused and a bit suspicious that the CPUC took only 11 days to change its mind on the suspension. I find this to be egregious and disingenuous. We have had no talks to address our concerns and it says to me that neither Waymo nor the CPUC care about local concerns over the public safety of our residents. This is why we need SB 915 The Autonomous Vehicle Service Deployment and Data Transparency Act by state Sen. Dave Cortese to pass in the Legislature. We need some local control over how robotaxis operate in the county because we know our roads and highways the best. We do not want to see the calamities that AVs have caused in San Francisco, including when a Waymo struck a bicyclist. In fact, robotaxis have caused all kinds of disastrous situations to the first responders in San Francisco including blocking the path of emergency vehicles responding to the scene of a mass shooting and entering an active fire scene, then parking on top of the fire hose. We want to avoid these dangerous scenarios in Silicon Valley and we need local control to do so. The county is now working with other jurisdictions who share are same concerns to determine what our next steps will be. Stay tuned!

See the ABC7 story on the issue here: [https://abc7news.com/waymo-robotaxi-san-mateo-county-la-expansion/14484113/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=f7ebba0ff6&e=c0babbc643)
---
---
| **Come celebrate the completion of Broadmoor’s Safe Routes to Schools project** The Broadmoor Safe Routes to School Pedestrian Improvements Project has completed and you are invited to join me for a ribbon cutting 10:30 a.m., Wednesday March 27 at the student drop off location off Park Plaza Drive near 87th Street. The estimated construction cost for this Project is $1,655,330 which includes $1,300,000 in federal Quick-Strike Program funding which I helped secure as a Commissioner on the Metropolitan Transportation Commission. The project includes installing pavement striping along the outside edges of the travel lanes on 87th Street to help provide drivers with a narrower sense of the roadway width. It also includes modifications at the intersection of 87th Street and Larchmont/Stoneyford Drive that will include painted medians and a painted bulb-out area at the corner of 87th Street and Larchmont Drive. These intersection modifications are intended to provide for a narrower area/travel lane to encourage drivers to slow down. The project stretches from 87th Street and Southgate Avenue to Sullivan Avenue and South Park Plaza Drive from 87th Street to approximately Palmcrest Drive. The work in general terms includes a raised midblock crosswalk on South Park Plaza Drive near Garden Village Elementary School and intersection improvements at 87th Street at South Park Plaza Drive/Nimitz Drive and 87th Street at Village Lane/Washington Street. I’m excited to see this project coming to completion as I’ve advocated for the safety of children walking to Garden Village and the nearby Ben Franklin Intermediate School. Thanks to the San Mateo Public Works department for overseeing this project which will benefit the neighborhood for generations to come.
---
| **Daly City welcomes Family Connections** I was excited to welcome Family Connections to Daly City Monday, February 12 at Susan B. Anthony Elementary School and cut the ribbon at its new family resources hub which offers free high-quality services in early childhood education, mental health, and family support for parents with children up to age 5. For 31 years, Family Connections has provided support through early learning classes, parent education and workshops, and mental health services in Redwood City and East Palo Alto. Through a partnership with the Jefferson Elementary School District, Family Connections is opening a site where families can access a variety of culturally authentic programming and services tailored to their unique needs. Family Connections helps families and children navigate toxic stress, food insecurity, the exorbitant cost of housing, which is all compounded by low wages. Recently, San Mateo County declared loneliness a public health crisis and Family Connections will help children and families find those deep connections that may have been lost during the pandemic. As a father of a 6-year-old, I can tell you that the more time I spend with my son reading, playing sports, or just hanging out and talking – the more confident and engaged he is. Early childhood education is so critical for social development. clean_body: | | | | | | | 2024 March e-newsletter News and information for District 5 in San Mateo County. | | | County offers new lifeline for those in mental health crisis | Dear friends, The Board of Supervisors unanimously voted Tuesday, February 27 to adopt a resolution authorizing a $4.9 million two-year agreement with Telecare Corporation for “Unarmed Mobile Mental Health Crisis Response Services” for individuals in crisis and their families who call 988 or the StarVista hotline at (650) 579-0350. We’ve seen suicide rates continue to climb which is a leading cause of death for children aged 10-14, young adults 20-34, and men, mostly white, 75 years and older. Now, the county will be able to provide unprecedented services, offering a new lifeline with in-person clinical support for those in crisis or feeling suicidal right where you live. This is 24/7 unarmed and compassionate approach meant to keep individuals out of our emergency rooms or jails and handled with care by trained clinicians. The service will partially begin in May with one team during evening weekday hours before fully ramping up by August to five 24/7 teams and two on-call teams. It will be for people who do not need immediate hospitalization. Once 988 calls are screened by StarVista, the hotline will dispatch clinicians trained in crisis assessment, de-escalation and intervention. They will arrive in nondescript vehicles – no lights and sirens – around-the-clock, any day of the year with the goal of stabilizing situations and, if necessary, taking individuals or arranging transportation to the appropriate level of care. The County along with Telecare and StarVista will develop an outreach campaign to promote awareness of the hotline number and the service. | Hasty CPUC decision on Waymo is shocking On Friday, March 1 the CPUC’s Consumer Protection and Enforcement Division (CPED) announced it will allow Waymo to operate in San Mateo and Los Angeles counties after it suspended its permit for up to 120 days Feb. 1 because of objections both counties made due to a lack of meaningful engagement to address public safety concerns. I thought the CPUC gave us 120 days to sit down with Waymo and discuss our concerns here in San Mateo County. I’m confused and a bit suspicious that the CPUC took only 11 days to change its mind on the suspension. I find this to be egregious and disingenuous. We have had no talks to address our concerns and it says to me that neither Waymo nor the CPUC care about local concerns over the public safety of our residents. This is why we need SB 915 The Autonomous Vehicle Service Deployment and Data Transparency Act by state Sen. Dave Cortese to pass in the Legislature. We need some local control over how robotaxis operate in the county because we know our roads and highways the best. We do not want to see the calamities that AVs have caused in San Francisco, including when a Waymo struck a bicyclist. In fact, robotaxis have caused all kinds of disastrous situations to the first responders in San Francisco including blocking the path of emergency vehicles responding to the scene of a mass shooting and entering an active fire scene, then parking on top of the fire hose. We want to avoid these dangerous scenarios in Silicon Valley and we need local control to do so. The county is now working with other jurisdictions who share are same concerns to determine what our next steps will be. Stay tuned! Why Conor O'Callaghan?
**Local Roots:** Conor's deep connection to our community is evident in his understanding of the unique challenges and opportunities we face. Raised in CD1, a product of the public schools system (taught by Senator Christine Marsh), and a proud resident of the district — he knows the issues that matter most to us. He and his wife Tina are raising their family here with three boys in public schools.

body:
From Congress to the statehouse, we will need to be all hands in to defeat Trump.
#
Did you see this?
Yesterday, the Supreme Court ruled that Colorado — or any state — does not have the authority to disqualify Donald Trump from running for federal office, despite his involvement with the January 6th insurrection.
Within minutes of the decision, Trump sent a fundraising blast calling the ruling a “BIG WIN”. Now, he’s heading into the final string of primary elections in the lead, completely unchecked, and fundraising off his crimes.
**Democrats on every level, from Congress to the statehouse, are going to have to fight back against Trump’s efforts to get back into the White House.**
[This is an all-hands-in moment. We’re going to need to motivate people in our movement to stand up where they haven’t before to defeat Trump. Will you make a contribution of $5 now to power our fight against MAGA extremism?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240305.p0fuoI&refcode=em20240305-5938-P_FND_RES_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5938%2E2526796%2ENwCA8r)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240305.p0fuoI&refcode=em20240305-5938-P_FND_RES_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=5938%2E2526796%2ENwCA8r)**
Colorado was the first of 19 states attempting to remove Trump from the ballot for violating Section 3 of the 14th Amendment to the Constitution, which disqualifies citizens that engage in rebellion or insurrection from holding public office.
In the ruling, SCOTUS’ conservative majority also required Congress to introduce legislation before disqualifying a candidate for violating the “insurrection ban.” All three liberal Justices — and even conservative Justice Amy Coney Barrett — disapproved, writing that the requirement would “insulate all alleged insurrectionists” in the future.
With Republicans in control of the House, SCOTUS’ conservative majority knows that requiring legislation means a significant delay in holding Trump to account.
[Which means our movement will have to work even harder to keep Trump out of the White House. Will you chip in $5 today to keep our movement going strong? Every contribution powers our grassroots campaign for progress.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240305.p0fuoI&refcode=em20240305-5938-P_FND_RES_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=5938%2E2526796%2ENwCA8r)
From all of us here on the campaign, we thank you for your support.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Trump vs. Biden
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Your feedback is important to me

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1950%2E4032634%2EsuAcB4)
---
The State of the Union is this Thursday — President Biden’s last SOTU address before the 2024 election. My guest will be a student loan borrower and teacher from Massachusetts who had her student debt canceled thanks to this team’s organizing and thanks to President Biden’s efforts to improve the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program. I’ll be glad to celebrate and honor the progress President Biden has made on canceling student debt so far (nearly $138 billion in student debt has been canceled for almost 3.9 million borrowers through more than two dozen executive actions). **But I want to know what you’re hoping to hear about at the State of the Union, too. Whether it’s abortion access, student debt cancellation, the economy, our democracy, or international affairs, there’s a lot to discuss as we gear up for this consequential election against Donald Trump.** [**Please let me know: What are your top priorities as we prepare for this fight ahead? What do you want Democrats to focus on and fight for? Click here to share your thoughts.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/wfs-ak-em-issues-survey/?source=EMZ19U_SUR_E_20240229_V1S1&t=8&akid=1950%2E4032634%2EsuAcB4) | [**TAKE SURVEY**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/wfs-ak-em-issues-survey/?source=EMZ19U_SUR_E_20240229_V1S1&t=9&akid=1950%2E4032634%2EsuAcB4)
---
Here’s the way I see it: when the American people see their elected officials making positive changes that touch their lives, they’re more likely to keep those leaders in office.
So when we have President Biden’s record in office compared to Trump’s, here’s what we see:
* Donald Trump has done two big things: Imposed an extremist Supreme Court that overturned Roe v. Wade, and passed a giant tax break that was mostly sucked up by millionaires, billionaires, and giant corporations.
* On the other hand, what does President Biden’s record show? Well, he's got $35 insulin and Medicare drug price negotiations for the first time, canceling all that student loan debt, passing the biggest climate package in the history of the world (paid for by my 15% tax on billionaire corporations that this movement fought hard for), getting the IRS the resources it needs to create a free filing system target wealthy tax cheats. And a whole lot more.

We know that if the GOP gains any more power in November, they’ll work to pass their extremist agenda and actively reverse all the progress we’ve made together. So I’m going to keep fighting with all I’ve got to keep Joe Biden in the White House.
**You help shape what I fight for, which is why I want to hear from you right now:**
[**This Thursday, when President Biden outlines his priorities for the rest of 2024 and beyond, what will you be listening for? What are you most determined to keep fighting for? Click here to submit a response and send me your thoughts.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/wfs-ak-em-issues-survey/?source=EMZ19U_SUR_E_20240229_V1S1&t=10&akid=1950%2E4032634%2EsuAcB4)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth
